jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description:

CityTeam is a Christian non-profit dedicated to supporting communities by meeting immediate needs and enabling lasting solutions for those struggling with poverty, homelessness, and addiction. Being part of CityTeam is not just a career but a calling. As ministerial representatives on the frontlines of our organization, we feel privileged to use our education, experience, and gifts to love people and bring glory to God.

A ministerial worker must be a Christ-centered individual who is active in a faith-based community, well-versed in Scripture, and passionate about helping clients grow in their relationship with Christ. In this dual role of spiritual guide and program manager, the worker provides spiritual direction, administrative oversight, and direct logistical coordination for individuals participating in our faith-based residential and recovery programs. The expectation for this role is that your daily life will serve as a living testimony to our program participants.

This is a Christian environment that values Teamwork, Accountability, Humility, Innovation, and Joy.

The Program Coordinator is an integral part of our team, providing structure, accountability, stability, and hope for those receiving services at CityTeam. This role is responsible for the day-to-day operations and logistics of our growing programs while serving as the go-to resource for clients, volunteers, and interns. Our ideal candidate is passionate about God’s transformational love, functions well under pressure, handles conflict with grace, and can pivot quickly in a fast-paced environment to serve as a living testimony to our participants.

This is a full-time, non-exempt position. Beyond salary, CityTeam offers a comprehensive benefits package, including Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance, Paid Vacation, Paid Holidays, Paid Sick Leave, and Retirement Benefits.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

**Spiritual Leadership & Ministerial Guidance**

* Devotional & Prayer: Facilitate and participate in daily/weekly devotional and prayer meetings.
* Biblical Guidance & Discipleship: Provide biblical guidance relevant to client needs.
* Spiritual Integration: Assist residents in identifying spiritual challenges, establishing daily spiritual disciplines, and seeking opportunities to encourage lasting life transformation through a personal relationship with Jesus Christ.
* Christian Witness & Culture: Model a consistent Christian lifestyle while cultivating a ministry culture centered on prayer, servant leadership, personal responsibility, forgiveness, reconciliation, and dependence upon God.

**Program Operations & Daily Oversight**

* Operational Coordination: Responsible for the day-to-day coordination of CityTeam programs under the direction of the supervisor, ensuring compliance with all operational policies and procedures.
* Scheduling & Facilitation: Schedule and facilitate program components, including discipleship groups, Bible studies, life-skills curriculum, and recreational activities.
* Client Supervision: Provide supervision and accountability for clients in all program areas, including general behavior, spiritual development, drug testing (UA) protocols as necessary, job placements, and program evaluations.
* Project Management: Manage multiple operational projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks effectively, and delegate responsibilities as needed to maintain smooth facility operations.

**Direct Services & Case Management Support**

* Case Management Assistance: Assist with direct case management services as needed, maintaining accurate, up-to-date case files and producing necessary program reports.
* Service Coordination: Collaborate with ministry staff to coordinate appropriate support services and maintain smooth transfer flows for all residents receiving services.
* Resource & Support Network: Serve as the primary go-to person for clients, volunteers, and interns to answer questions, resolve issues, and navigate daily program processes.

**Volunteer, Intern & Team Leadership**

* Coaching & Leadership: Provide spiritual leadership, biblically based training, and coaching to program subordinates, volunteers, and interns.
* Staff Strategy: Utilize effective leadership strategies to encourage spiritual growth, excellence, and biblical compassion among interns, volunteers, and program participants.

**Transportation & Logistics**

* Transportation: Provide safe transportation for residents essential appointments, off-site activities, and program events as needed.
* Supply & Errand Logistics: Assist with administrative errands, supply pickups, and program logistical needs.

**Administration & Other Duties**

* Reporting & Compliance: Maintain data integrity, compile operational reports, and track metrics as requested by ministry leadership.
* Adaptability & Special Projects: Respond to unexpected operational shifts with grace and a Christ-like attitude, performing additional administrative tasks and special projects as assigned by the supervisor.

Requirements:

**ELIGIBILITY QUALIFICATIONS FOR MINISTERIAL ROLES**

* Must have an intimate, personal relationship with Jesus Christ.
* Must be active in a local Christian body of believers and engaged in community with other Christ-followers.
* Must hold compatible theology with the major issues outlined in CityTeam's Statement of Faith.

**REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* Biblical Knowledge: Working knowledge of biblical concepts with the demonstrated ability to teach, lead, and model these concepts to the individuals CityTeam serves.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, Human Services, or equivalent combination of education and operational experience.
* Administrative Experience: Minimum of 2 years of administrative, program coordination, or operational experience.
* Technical Skills: Computer literacy with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel) or Google Workspace, and experience with database entry.

jobs.title: Resident Services Coordinator/ Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Join our team and make a difference in people’s lives! LifeSTEPS is committed to build thriving communities by empowering individuals and families through supportive housing and services.**

We are seeking a highly motivated **Director of Social Services & Program Coordinator** who will:

* Empower low-income individuals and families to flourish by providing education and resources.
* Ensure our residents, specifically older adults to have an opportunity to thrive in place through housing and services.
* Encourage individuals and families through stable housing and supportive evidence-based services to build resilient communities.
* Maximize the strengths of individuals by providing client assistance, case management, service coordination and conducting community outreach.

**Additional duties will include:**

* Empowering children from low-income and underserved families to flourish by providing After School education and resources.
* Ensure our young individuals a caring and safe place to go to After School to get assistance with homework and academic enrichment.
* Encourage children to thrive and become empowered so they can develop into resilient adults.

**Job Specifics:**

* **Title:** Director of Social Services/Program Coordinator
* **Job classification:** Non-Exempt, 35 hours per week
* **Job location:** Fremont, CA
* **Pay range:** $21.00- $28.35/hr

**More about us:**

The **STEP** in **LifeSTEPS** stands for **“Skills Training and Educational Programs”** and is the heart of our mission. We believe community development is built “One STEP at a time.” Our vision is that every person served by **LifeSTEPS** will be empowered with the skills, resources, and support to maintain stable housing and break the cycle of poverty. Our founders believe that building affordable housing is only the first step. It is also essential to provide meaningful programs that empower people to move forward in their lives.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology or any related field.
* Two (2) years of experience in a similar environment providing social services to multi-families, senior and children.
* An equivalent combination of education and experience may substitute for the degree
* A background or experience working for a non-profit would be a big plus!
* Valid California Driving License and reliable, insured transportation required

Are you ready to make a difference, stand behind and support people so they achieve their goals and become empowered to move forward in their lives? **Apply today!!!**

Current authorization to work in the United States is required. Because this role may involve access to export-controlled technology or information, employment eligibility and access permissions will be evaluated in accordance with applicable U.S. export-control laws and company policy.

jobs.title: Senior People Operations Manager (Senior HR Generalist)
jobs.description:
**Senior People Operations Manager (Senior HR Generalist)**

**About Inferra**

Inferra builds hyperscaler-quality AI infrastructure as standardized, modular blocks that are assembled onsite, not constructed, and combine to build any data center at any scale, anywhere. Built to Tier III standards, our platforms support NVIDIA Blackwell and Vera Rubin and a growing range of accelerators, from 1–2 MW at the edge to 100 MW–1 GW campuses, live about six months from order.

Power is the constraint on AI, and powered land is the heart of our offer. We have secured more than 3 GW of powered land across thousands of 2–5 MW sites, hundreds of 5–20 MW sites and dozens of 20–100 MW sites, and the portfolio grows every month. Because our modules are small, quiet, need no water connection and go where infrastructure already exists, we can use power that traditional data centers cannot.

We serve frontier labs, hyperscalers, inference clouds and enterprises. Inferra is backed by General Catalyst and led by a founding team that has built and scaled infrastructure companies before.

**The Role**

Inferra is about to grow from about 20 people to a company that deploys 420 MW in 2027, at 35 sites a month from July. You'll be our second People hire and you'll run the HR operating engine that makes that ramp possible: fast, well-run hiring, a great first week for every new employee, and compliance in every state where we employ people.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You'll build processes from scratch, run them yourself, and get them ready for a company several times our size. You'll work closely with the VP of People, the founders and every team lead.

**What You'll Do**

* **Speed to hire.** Run recruiting coordination in Ashby: scheduling, candidate communication, references, background checks and offer paperwork, so offers go out in hours, not weeks.
* **Onboarding.** Own onboarding from signed offer to day 1 and through 30, 60 and 90-day check-ins, so every new hire is productive in their first week.
* **Multi-state compliance.** Own daily compliance across California, Washington, Colorado, Kansas and new states as we grow: I-9s, state notices, required training, leave, final pay and personnel records.
* **Payroll, benefits and HR systems.** Administer payroll and benefits through Insperity, run open enrollment, and lead the project to move to an in-house HR system such as Rippling.
* **SOC 2.** Run the HR controls behind SOC 2: background checks, signed agreements, security training, and onboarding and offboarding records tied to system access. Keep the evidence audit-ready.
* **Policies.** Publish and maintain the employee handbook and multi-state policies with counsel, and roll out working norms across the company.
* **Employee relations.** Be the first point of contact for employee questions and concerns; document, advise and escalate to the VP of People.
* **Data and reporting.** Keep people data accurate across Ashby, payroll and the HR system, and produce the monthly people dashboard.

**Who You Are**

* 8+ years in HR or People Operations, including 3+ years at a venture-backed startup through rapid growth
* Hands-on with multi-state employment compliance, especially California
* Experience with PEOs and HR systems such as Insperity, TriNet, Rippling, Gusto or BambooHR
* Has run benefits, payroll, onboarding and offboarding end to end
* Has supported recruiting at volume, ideally in Ashby or a similar applicant tracking system
* Has supported a SOC 2 or similar audit with HR controls and evidence
* Organized, fast and discreet; comfortable building from nothing and doing the work yourself

**Nice to Have**

* Has moved a company from a PEO to an in-house HR system
* Experience with field, construction or data center workforces, contractors and staffing agencies
* Experience with work visas (H-1B, PERM) alongside immigration counsel
* SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR or SPHR certification

**What Success Looks Like**

* **Day 30:** Onboarding playbook live for the January starts; day-1 kit and offboarding checklist in use; multi-state compliance audit done, with gaps fixed or scheduled.
* **Day 60:** Benefits guide and open-enrollment plan; handbook and multi-state policies drafted for counsel; 30/60/90 check-ins running for every hire.
* **Day 90:** Recommendation on staying with Insperity or moving in-house; HR controls mapped for SOC 2; recruiting coordination running for every open role.

**Why Inferra**

* **Founding People team.** You'll build People Operations at a company scaling fast, with direct access to the founders.
* **Real impact.** Your work decides how fast we can hire and how well we keep the people we hire.
* **Meaningful ownership.** Founding-level equity in a company building critical infrastructure for the AI era.

**Equal Opportunity**

Inferra is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you need an accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, email [careers@inferra.ai]. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act and applicable local law.

**Recruiters and Agencies**

Inferra does not accept unsolicited résumés from recruiters or agencies. Please don't contact our employees or send candidate profiles. We won't pay a fee for any candidate submitted without a signed agreement with Inferra.

jobs.description:
Description:

Now is the time to join Union City Modern Dentistry. You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!

Overview:

The role of the Operations Manager Trainee (OMT) is to gain an understanding of the skills and company knowledge to independently run a financially viable PDS supported dental office. The OMT is responsible for engaging in and owning their professional development through completing the OM Development Program while being supported by their direct supervisor. This will be done in a variety of ways: through structured curriculum completion, on the job practical application and development meetings. The OMT role is hired with the expectations that each individual will be able to independently manage a dental office in 4-6 months, following timely completion of the OM Development Program.

**Responsibilities**

* Modeling company culture, values, standards and best operational practices based on the We Believe Behavioral Framework; actively learning how to create an environment that promotes PDS culture and values daily
* Assessment, hiring and retention of right fit team members through comprehensive training, supervision, counseling and coaching
* Assess, investigate, and resolve staff and patient issues by analyzing the facts and circumstances to develop timely, effective, logical yet creative solutions
* Execution of the PDS Operational Model with consistency to meet identified office imperatives in partnership with the Owner Dentist
* Driving year over year revenue and profit growth
* Management of expenses to achieve monthly goals and budget
* Show proficiency and adherence to cash management and accounting protocols
* How to be the catalyst in team development of the Perfect Patient Experience
* How to deliver effective leadership, coaching and mentoring with team members in an effort to identify and implement opportunities for improvement

* Maintains an appropriate professional appearance and demeanor in accordance with company policies; addresses others professionally and respectfully
* Gains proficiency and understands the tools and resources available with regards to People related functions, such as assessment, hiring, retention, performance evaluation, separation processes and compensation guidance and execution
* Ensure Compliance with Company policies, as well as State, Federal and other regulatory bodies
* Report weekly to Regional Manager detailing accomplishments, areas for improvement, clear performance goals, and effectiveness of systems
* By end of development program, show competency in managing a team of both Front Office and Back Office team members, displaying leadership and team development capabilities
* Develop and implement an office success plan; including development of staff, and office protocols to provide for efficient operations during manager absences
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned by direct supervisor that will result in improved team member development outcomes

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent
* Five or more years of related work experience in operational management

**Preferred**

* Associate degree, Bachelor’s degree
* Five or more years of experience leading a team, mentoring and coaching subordinates

* Results Oriented (Energetic self-starter; sets realistic goals; meets commitments; persistent, prioritizes daily to achieve results)
* Effective Team Builder (Character/Integrity; communicates openly; willingness to confront; motivator/inspirer; educator/trainer, promotes learning; effective assessor of talent; consistent)
* Patient Advocate (flexible and adaptive; empathetic; passionate; ethical
* Process Focused Operator (data driven decision-maker; detailed; organized and structured; comprehensive knowledge of all operational processes; computer proficient)
* Financial Acumen (understands profit drivers; utilizes metrics to manage; builds the financial understanding of staff and clinicians; understands local market drivers and competition
* Influencer (active listener/observer of behavior; builds trust with those requiring coaching; creates a win/win need for change; tailors coaching style to the individual’s needs; recognizes and celebrates improvement to sustain change)

jobs.title: Safety and Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Join our team as a Safety and Operations Manager in Paratransit Operations, where your leadership will support safe, reliable, and compassionate transportation for our community. In this role, you will oversee safety programs, employee training, accident prevention, and daily dispatch and reservations activities. You will work closely with AP3 leadership, frontline employees, and client agencies to strengthen safety performance, maintain compliance, and deliver quality service.

**We Offer:**

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

**Responsibilities:**

* Recruit and screen potential new hire operator candidates to be placed into training, ensuring that efforts meet the staffing needs of the project.
* Manage new hire and veteran operator training programs to ensure that all operators receive the minimum initial training and that all employees receive required annual and ongoing training.
* Provide and/or manage classroom and behind-the-wheel instruction according to AP3 and contract specifications in all aspects of vehicle operation in the course of passenger transportation, including defensive driving, service area familiarization, passenger loading, unloading and securement, proper manifest documentation, use of on-board equipment, accident and emergency procedures, dispatch and radio communications, and passenger sensitivity.
* Provide and/or manage monthly or annual ongoing and refresher training in topics relevant to the service and service area, and in a timely manner.
* Manage AP3's employer road testing program, including course design, scoring rubric, and evaluator calibration, so that evaluations are consistent across supervisors.
* Respond to and/or provide for trained staff response to operator accidents and incidents, ensuring appropriate collection of information, documentation of events, and reporting per AP3 and contract policy.
* Review all vehicular, passenger, and employee accidents and incidents for determination of cause and preventability, identifying potential trends to be addressed in future training efforts as well as ensuring that retraining and safety points are assessed according to AP3 policy.
* Serve on the Accident Review Committee and maintain written preventability criteria so that determinations are consistent and defensible.
* Manage all aspects of AP3's FTA drug and alcohol testing program in compliance with FTA regulations, including pre-employment, random, reasonable suspicion, post-accident, return-to-duty, and follow-up testing.
* Serve as, or as backup to, the Designated Employer Representative (DER); construct and maintain the random testing pool and verify selection frequency and rates; maintain a clear post-accident testing decision process and the applicable timeframes; and deliver or coordinate the required reasonable suspicion training for all supervisors.
* Manage the third-party administrator, Medical Review Officer, Substance Abuse Professional, and collection site relationships. Conduct regular reviews of local testing facilities ensuring compliance with federal and AP3 policy, maintain chain-of-custody integrity and confidential recordkeeping, complete required program reporting, and keep AP3's drug and alcohol policy current with regulatory change.
* Establish a functional Safety Committee of operators and staff to review safety concerns and make recommendations to management for additional safety efforts.
* Own AP3's written safety programs, including the Injury and Illness Prevention Program, heat illness prevention, workplace violence prevention, emergency action, and hazard communication plans.
* Build and manage the dash cam coaching program, including event review workflow, severity thresholds, coaching documentation, and driver scorecards.
* Assist operations and maintenance departments in identifying additional or refresher training needs based on current trends within the employee base.
* Ensure complete and accurate documentation of all training activities and accurate completion of all training-related employee records.
* Work with AP3 leadership and claims partners to ensure that all liability and workers' compensation claims are handled promptly and effectively, in an effort to reduce financial liability as well as recoup on all subrogatable claims.
* Proactively manage all employee injury claims to minimize lost time and light duty claims. Work with local medical facilities to ensure that injured employees are placed on light duty as quickly as possible and are returned to full-duty status promptly.
* Conduct regular audits of employee training files and vehicle maintenance files, and conduct regular facility safety audits ensuring compliance with Cal/OSHA and EPA regulations and related AP3 policies.
* Ensure that operator performance reviews, ride-alongs, road checks, and evaluations are conducted according to AP3 and contract policy and requirements. Provide feedback and follow up for operator performance reviews and identify individual training needs where necessary.
* Hire and manage all safety department employees, including classroom and behind-the-wheel instructors, ensuring that all safety staff have the appropriate qualifications, certifications, and training, and that staff assignments are made in consideration of applicable budget line items.
* Write and maintain standard operating procedures for the safety program's core processes.
* Provide regular reports to AP3 leadership and client agencies on safety department efforts, claims status, training efforts, accident history, workers' compensation claims status, and other required information.

* Maintain a positive work environment by providing all employees with fair and equitable supervision and encouraging professional growth.

* Continually monitor cleaning operations to ensure all activities are completed promptly and correctly.
* Responsible for staff development in areas such as training, technical skills, safety, and performance management.
* Assist in recruiting/hiring/onboarding of new team members.
* Complete annual performance reviews and provide professional development opportunities.
* Monitor and maintain budgeted labor hours at assigned sites/accounts.
* Maintain project calendar, develop agendas, record minutes and action items and facilitate meetings.
* Manage cross-functional team resources appropriately to ensure effective team performance and achieve goals.
* Plan, organize and lead projects to improve efficiency and productivity and identify/implement best practices.
* Identify and resolve technical, procedural and equipment issues that hinder cleaning performance.
* Follow Good Manufacturing Practices where applicable.
* Manage inventory levels at customer sites.
* Represent the company at customer meetings and perform quarterly business reviews with key clients.
* Ensures accurate time/attendance recording and labor law compliance.
* P&L & Financial reporting experience
* Demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Demonstrates excellent documentation skills, and adhere to all regulations
* Demonstrates excellent problem solving/issue resolution skills
* Ability to stay calm and rational under pressure
* Adheres to all policy and conduct standards and embraces the culture of Controlled
* Must have a high level of attention to detail and excellent time management skills
* All other duties as defined by your supervisor

***EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:***

* 3+ years direct business operations experience

***PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:***

Required to spend on-the-job time on the following physical activities:

* Operate a motor vehicle
* Stand – Walk – Lift – Climb – Talk - Hear
* Use hands to finger, handle or feel - Reach with hands or arms
* The Weight or Force requirement in this position is: Up to 30 pounds

jobs.description:
Meta's Product Data Operations (PDO) team is looking for a Data Operations Program Manager to own workforce management for the in-house robotics data collection program. This person will be the full-time operational owner of contingent workforce (CW) staffing, onboarding, shift allocation and performance management, working with staffing suppliers and on-site leads.You will ensure the program has the right number of trained operators in the right shifts, respond to changing staffing needs and make operator performance visible and actionable. Success means proactively identifying underperformance and measurement gaps, meeting hiring needs, understanding and addressing attrition drivers, and reducing onboarding friction. The role requires hands-on execution, analytical judgment and consistent follow-through with staffing suppliers and cross-functional partners.

* escalate risks early with a plan to close them
* Support hiring sprints with recruiting and staffing partners. Track the hiring pipeline, time-to-fill, start dates and onboarding capacity
* identify bottlenecks and drive actions to meet staffing needs

* track and resolve recurring delays
* Build and maintain operator-level performance reporting using relevant quality, productivity, attendance and training-readiness measures. Identify and close measurement gaps so performance management is consistent, timely and actionable
* Proactively identify low-performing operators rather than waiting for other teams to flag them. Investigate the drivers, coordinate coaching and improvement actions with staffing suppliers and on-site leads, and drive timely offboarding of persistent low performers through the appropriate partners
* Monitor attrition, attendance and staffing shortfalls. Understand their drivers, distinguish preventable issues from changes in demand, and drive retention, replacement or shift-allocation actions with clear owners and timelines

* 4+ years of experience in program, project or operations management
* Experience managing staffing suppliers or outsourced/contingent workforces, including staffing plans, onboarding and performance reviews
* Experience coordinating hiring or staffing ramp-ups and maintaining coverage across shifts or changing operational needs
* Experience using operator-level quality, productivity or attendance measures to identify underperformance and drive improvement actions
* Experience investigating staffing shortfalls or attrition, identifying root causes and driving corrective actions with cross-functional partners

And nobody at Google loves big numbers like the Finance team when providing in depth analysis on all manner of strategic decisions across Google products. Bill Wilson Center provides services to children, youth, young adults, and families in Santa Clara County. Additionally, we reach clients through our street outreach and crisis line programs. Bill Wilson Center programs focus on housing, mental health care, supportive services, and advocacy. Bill Wilson Center is committed to working with the community to ensure that every youth has access to the range of services needed to grow to be healthy and self-sufficient adults. A key component of Bill Wilson Center's philosophy encompasses a strength-based approach to improving the lives of the youth and young families in our communities. Bill Wilson Center has been providing services to runaway and homeless youth since 1973. Join us and become a difference maker at Bill Wilson Center!

The Site Operation Program Manager is an important part of the Enhanced Short-Term Residential Therapeutic Program (E-STRTP) management team supporting the agency mission and vision to help our most vulnerable population of foster youth achieve self-sufficiency and life skills needed towards reaching their unique hopes and dreams. jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
**About the job**
-----------------

**Cuttable exists because creativity shouldn’t be what slows marketing teams down.**

The world’s biggest advertising platforms demand more ads than most teams can produce. But production is still slow, expensive and built for a different era. Briefs pile up. Creative teams burn out. Marketers can’t keep up.

Cuttable fixes that.

We’re an AI Creative Production System that helps ecommerce brands create, test and launch ads across Meta, TikTok and Google at the volume the platforms actually reward.

More than 300 brands across North America and Asia Pacific already use Cuttable. We're backed by Square Peg, Rampersand and AirTree, following one of the largest seed rounds in Australian tech history. Offices in Melbourne and New York.

Our CEO and co-founder, Sam Kroonenburg, has built and scaled a global technology company before. Now we’re doing it again.

**Join us and help make good ads, instantly.**

### **The role**

**Pay range: $98,000 – $147,000 USD per year**

Cuttable's US business is scaling fast, and we're standing up a dedicated Implementation function in San Francisco to make sure that growth doesn't outpace the experience new customers get. Right now, activation — getting a brand live and publishing ads fast — determines whether a new customer ever finds a winning ad and sticks around. That's this role.

You'll own the activation outcome for every new US customer: running onboarding from kickoff through their first ads live, working the day-by-day playbook that gets brands to 20 published ads within their first 14 days, and handing off a fully activated, confident customer to the Account Executive or Account Manager who takes it from there. This is a hands-on, implementation-led role, not an ongoing account management one, and you'll be one of the first people building it in the US.

We're not looking for someone who just runs onboarding calls and waits for customers to figure it out. We want someone who treats every account's first two weeks as the moment that decides everything after it: proactive, hands-on, and relentless about getting brands to value fast.

Done well, six months in:

* Your accounts are consistently hitting the 20-ads-in-14-days activation standard, and you know which accounts are off track before anyone has to tell you.
* Handoffs to AEs and Account Managers are clean — the next owner isn't starting cold, and nobody's chasing you for context.
* There's a real, repeatable onboarding playbook that didn't exist before you built it.
* Customers' first impression of Cuttable in the US is a great one, because of you.

### **Who we look for**

We hire for values as much as experience, because mindset carries you through the parts no job description can predict. Here's what that looks like day to day at cuttable:

* **Be Brave & Own It**: you take smart risks and you own what happens next, good or bad. You own the outcome, not just the intention.
* **Create Customer Magic**: you listen hard enough to get to what customers actually need, not just what they said.
* **Say It (With Care)**: You say the honest thing, directly, and with genuine care for the person hearing it.
* **Progress Beats Perfection**: you'd rather ship, learn, and improve than sit on something waiting for it to be flawless.
* **Work Hard, Laugh Often**: you take the work seriously. Never yourself.

We believe you'll succeed in this role if you have:

* Solid experience in Customer Success, Implementation, Onboarding, or Account Management within B2B SaaS — ideally with hands-on ownership of a defined, metrics-driven onboarding or activation motion, not just relationship management.
* The ability to run a structured onboarding process end-to-end: configuring a new customer's setup, running onboarding and activation calls with confidence, and reading usage data to know exactly which accounts are on track and which need an immediate intervention.
* You embrace AI and every other tool that helps you move faster. Great judgment beats doing everything manually.
* You're comfortable with ambiguity and would rather create the playbook than wait for one.
* You're genuinely curious and love tackling the messy, unglamorous problems that others avoid.

### **What we offer**

* **Equity:** If you're helping build Cuttable, you should own a piece of what it becomes.
* **Market-rate pay, reviewed annually:** The people building Cuttable's success should be rewarded as the company grows, with regular reviews to make sure we're staying competitive.
* **For our US team** we offer a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental and vision coverage, as well as a 401(k) retirement plan.
* **5 weeks of paid time off (PTO / annual leave):** Your 5 weeks includes our team-wide festive season shutdown, so everyone gets a proper break together. No half-logging in with Slack open in another tab.
* **Your birthday off, always:** Because there's only one you. *Work Hard, Laugh Often* isn't just about celebrating the big wins; it's about celebrating the people who make them happen.
* **Paid parental leave:** 12 weeks at base pay for primary carers and 6 weeks at base pay for secondary carers. We're proud to help people build great careers at Cuttable while supporting them as they build and grow their families.
* **Offices in Melbourne and New York (and soon San Francisco!), with flexibility built in:** We like the people we work with, so we've created spaces worth showing up to. But we don't measure commitment by chair time—work from home when that's what the day needs.
* **A tech allowance:** AU$750 / US$500 to set your workspace up properly, wherever you're working from.

*At cuttable, we're building a team as diverse as the businesses we serve. We're an equal opportunity employer and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender identity, or gender expression, sexual orient

**Project Manager Opportunity at Stanford Federal Credit Union!**

**We’re on a mission to improve financial lives!** If you’re a high-energy, compassionate, and collaborative individual with a desire to make a difference, we encourage you to consider joining our SFCU team! Members really do come first at Stanford FCU because we’re non-profit and owned by our members. Our members work for Stanford University or some of the most innovative companies in Silicon Valley—and we provide them with the most generous financial benefits in our industry.

Stanford FCU is a $4.5 billion company with a global reach of over 95,000 members in 90 countries and growing! Come grow with us and see what it’s like to work for a Bay Area Top Workplace. As our CEO says, “we work hard, and we play hard”, and we need *your* help to improve even more financial lives!

As a Project Manager at Stanford FCU, you will be an essential part of our dynamic team, steering the successful completion of critical projects that support our strategic goals. You will be responsible for initiating, planning, executing, controlling, and closing projects while managing the scope, schedule, resources, and risk to deliver solutions that enhance our member service offerings. Your role will demand effective collaboration with cross-functional teams, diligent stakeholder management, and a deep understanding of project management principles. Proficiency in financial industry regulations and experience in a credit union or banking environment will be key to your success in driving innovation and improvements that uphold our commitment to member satisfaction and operational excellence.

**\*This position is hybrid onsite in Palo Alto, CA\***

**Who YOU are:**

* Expertise in applying project management principles, methodologies, and tools to manage all project lifecycle phases.
* Capable of analyzing complex problems, identifying potential solutions, and making decisions based on data.
* Proven ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams, influence without authority, and drive projects to completion.
* Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, ensuring that projects stay on track.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and adapt to project scope, schedule, and resource changes.
* Proficient in negotiating terms and resolving conflicts, ensuring the project’s best interests are always front and center.
* Understanding budgeting and financial planning related to project management, with the ability to effectively forecast and control project costs.

**What YOU’LL do:**

* Responsible for preparing and executing project plans on approved projects.
* Oversees all aspects of projects, including due diligence, initiation, planning, execution, and closing stages.
* Manages and implements project changes/interventions to achieve completion.
* Conduct project post-implementation reviews. Coordinate and communicate effectively with various teams to meet project objectives.
* Resolve project issues, mitigate risks, and manage scope changes effectively.
* Facilitate regular status meetings and report project progress to stakeholders.
* Train and mentor internal staff members on project management methodologies and best practices.

**Some of our benefits for YOU:**

* 100% paid employee medical, dental, vision, life/AD&D and short-term disability insurance for the employee; 70% paid for dependents
* Quarterly incentives up to 10% of your salary (based on position)

* Education reimbursement based on eligibility
* Employee recognition program with cash incentives
* Commuter Toll Benefit $100-$200/month (based on position)

* Paid Sick Time accrues at two weeks per year
* Paid Vacation Time accrues at three weeks per year
* Paid Federal banking holidays (approximately 11 per year)
* Ongoing training and education, seminars, and conferences
* Loan rate discounts on some products (vehicle, mortgage and HELOC loans)
* Waived fees and deposit bonuses on Stanford FCU accounts
* Flex health/transit plan availability
* Employee Assistance Program with free benefits like counseling, help finding legal assistance and day care resources

Stanford Federal Credit Union provides pay ranges representing its good faith estimate of what the Credit Union reasonably expects to pay for a position. The pay offered to a selected candidate will be determined based on factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the qualifications of the selected candidate, departmental budget availability, internal equity, geographic location, and external market pay for comparable jobs.

If you are ready for this awesome opportunity (or know somebody who is) please contact us today!

**Please Note:** SFCU does not provide work visa sponsorship or accept visa transfers for any positions. Applicants that require work visa sponsorship or transfer will not be considered for employment. SFCU does not provide any relocation benefits for any positions.

**About LCC3 Solution Inc**

LCC3 Solution Inc. provides industrial design-build services, including design coordination, procurement, construction management, installation, and commissioning for advanced manufacturing and high-tech facilities. We are seeking organized, proactive project assistants to support our Project Managers and grow within industrial construction.

**Position Summary**

Support the PM with daily coordination, written communication, schedules, procurement, cost records, and project documentation. This hands-on role supports industrial facilities, cleanrooms, and laboratory projects. Success means keeping accurate records, following up on commitments, and escalating issues early with a clear status and next action.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

***Project Coordination***

* Maintain action and issue logs with responsible parties, due dates, and status; follow up with owners, designers, subcontractors, and suppliers until items are resolved.
* Update schedules, milestones, and short-term lookaheads using field input; flag late approvals, missing owner information, design dependencies, and delivery risks to the PM.
* Coordinate meetings across U.S. and China time zones; prepare agendas, record decisions, and distribute minutes and follow-up actions.

***Subcontractor and Vendor Management***

* Prepare RFQs, organize quotations, and compile comparisons of scope, exclusions, price, lead time, and delivery terms for PM review.
* Prepare purchase order documentation for approval; track submittal approvals, fabrication, shipping, and delivery commitments, especially for long-lead equipment.
* Coordinate deliveries, site access, unloading, and storage with the field team; record shortages, damage, and outstanding supplier items.

***Documentation and Project Administration***

* Maintain organized contracts, drawings, revisions, RFIs, submittals, meeting minutes, and correspondence; distribute current documents and track responses and approvals.
* Follow up with U.S. Architects/Engineers and overseas design teams on drawing updates, owner inputs, and outstanding technical questions.
* Maintain a potential change order log; compile owner instructions, emails, drawing revisions, field records, quotations, and schedule impacts for PM review.
* Help prepare change order proposals, progress payment applications, schedule of values updates, and invoice tracking; check supporting documents and flag discrepancies.

***Site Support and Quality Assurance***

* Collect daily reports, progress photos, manpower information, and field constraints; compare reported progress with planned activities and notify the PM of deviations.
* Track permit and inspection status, required documents, and corrective actions with the field team and Architect/Engineer; support TCO/CO preparation and closeout.
* Maintain punch lists and coordinate testing and turnover records, including cleanroom test reports, equipment startup records, as-builts, warranties, and O&M manuals.
* Follow site safety requirements, use required PPE, and promptly report observed safety or quality concerns to the responsible field leader and PM.

***Communication and Reporting***

* Draft clear English and Mandarin emails, meeting summaries, and project updates; accurately communicate technical and commercial information between project teams.
* Prepare a concise weekly status report covering progress, procurement, pending decisions, changes, and risks; highlight items requiring PM action.
* Work under PM direction. Obtain approval before issuing commitments involving price, scope, schedule, or contract terms; route technical approvals to the responsible professionals.

**Required Qualifications**

* Fluent written and spoken English and Mandarin; able to draft professional emails and take accurate meeting minutes in both languages.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and persistent follow-up; able to manage competing deadlines and ask clear questions when information is incomplete.
* Proficiency in Excel, Word, Outlook, and Teams; able to maintain tracking spreadsheets, compare quotations, and organize project files.
* Comfort working with drawings, quantities, and basic construction terminology, with the ability to learn unfamiliar systems and identify questions for the PM.
* Ability to read design drawings and coordinate with design institutes
* Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and ability to work on-site and travel between project locations as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 1–3 years of experience in construction, engineering, manufacturing, or project coordination; relevant internships will also be considered.
* Exposure to industrial, cleanroom, semiconductor, or laboratory projects, including mechanical, electrical, plumbing, or process utility coordination.
* Experience with RFIs, submittals, procurement, change orders, or payment applications; familiarity with Bluebeam, Procore, Microsoft Project, or similar tools.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to walk active construction sites, wear required PPE, travel between sites, and occasionally lift up to 25 pounds, with reasonable accommodation as applicable.

Competitive salary based on experience; company-sponsored benefits subject to eligibility; hands-on mentorship; and opportunities to grow into project engineering or project management responsibilities.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Facilities
jobs.description:
The Judicial Council of California is accepting applications for the position of Project Manager, Facilities with the Facilities Services office.

Under the supervision of the unit manager, the Project Manager exercises independent judgment with the planning, design and construction of renovation and improvement projects of all scopes and sizes. Incumbents are also responsible for budget and schedule tracking, design management, and/or project administration. Workload and count will vary based on project complexity, but generally this position will manage 12-20 projects concurrently. Today, these positions are required to manage an average of 8.6 projects per year, with an estimated value of $5.6M approved by the Trial Court Facilities Modification Working Group. Work includes the necessary processes and procedures to develop and manage the execution of Facility Modifications. Facility Modifications (FM) projects include but are not limited to minor construction, tenant improvements, system and infrastructure renewal, and equipment replacement.

**The Judicial Council**
  
The Judicial Council of California is the policy setting body for the state court system and has constitutionally conferred statewide rule-making authority. This authority includes developing, advocating for, and allocating the judicial branch budget. A majority of Council members are California state justices and judges; however, the Council also includes lawyers, legislators, and court administrators.

By enhancing its role as a leadership, knowledge, and service resource for the judicial branch, the Judicial Council’s staff organization seeks to continue to evolve as one of California’s most dynamic public service entities, focused on improving access to justice for all Californians by innovating and responding to the changing needs of the courts and the public. As a government body charged with improving the statewide administration of justice, the Judicial Council has multiple offices with diverse responsibilities relating to court policy and operations. As employees of the council, every member of staff should view and approach their work as one Judicial Council with a public service mission that is greater than the sum of its parts.

The Judicial Council strives for work life balance and includes substantial vacation and holiday time. In addition, we offer an excellent benefits package including pension, medical, dental and vision coverage, flexible spending, up to $130 per month reimbursement for qualifying commuting costs, student loan forgiveness as part of Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), and retirement savings plans. In Sacramento, the office is located minutes from downtown, just north of Discovery Park. The San Francisco office is only a 7-minute walk from the Civic Center BART station.

The Judicial Council offers hybrid work arrangements for many positions. The successful candidate will be expected to work in person at the Judicial Council’s San Francisco or Sacramento office at least two days per week, based on their office leader’s direction, and reside in the areas surrounding these locations. To be eligible for Judicial Council employment and participation in the Judicial Council’s Hybrid Work Program, a prospective or current employee’s primary residence/remote work location must be in the State of California and within a 150-mile driving radius of their assigned reporting location.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* FM Development and Estimating
  + Develop detailed project scope for execution of FM projects.
  + Document scope and develop preliminary cost estimates documentation.
* Communication on FM Projects
  + Meet with court, county, contactors, and other customers to evaluate project needs and requirements.
  + Coordinate and hold FM project meetings to provide project status, coordination of schedules, and deliverables.
* FM Project Execution and Management
  + Coordinate building access and hours of services between court and county customers and FM contractors, subcontractors, and other support services.
  + Manage and participate in project kick-off meetings with all project stakeholders.
* FM Contracting
  + Develop RFP, RFQ, and RFI documents in accordance with the JCC contracting policy.
  + Develop and manage contract selection process and document appropriate award justification.
* Project Closeout
  + Develop individual project close-out requirements based on JCC guidelines.
  + Review requirements with contractors during initial site walks and project estimating discussions.

**Qualifications**
------------------

  

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
  
Bachelor’s degree, preferably in architecture, engineering, building engineering, or construction management, and four (4) years of construction/project management experience. An additional four
  
(4) years of professional experience as noted above may substitute for the bachelor’s degree. Or, additional directly related experience and/or education may be substituted on a year-for-year basis.

Four (4) years as a Facilities Management Administrator with the Judicial Council of California or four (4) years of experience performing the duties of a class comparable in the level of responsibility to that of a Facilities Management Administrator in a California superior court or California state- level government entity.

**Job Summary/Objective:**

The Project Manager II oversees medium-scale projects with moderate scope and complexity. This position is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing projects while ensuring objectives are met within designated timelines, budgets, and quality standards. The role involves collaborating with project teams, clients, vendors, and stakeholders to address potential risks and ensure successful project delivery. For wireless telecommunications projects, this position may support zoning, permitting, entitlement, and jurisdictional approval activities in accordance with project and client requirements. It serves as an intermediate step in project management, requiring a deeper understanding of project management processes, tools, and principles.

* Confidence in decision-making under pressure, effectively managing trade-offs between risks and opportunities.

* Leadership skills to set an example and contribute positively in cross-functional team settings.
* Exceptional attention to detail to proactively identify and mitigate risks, ensuring project success.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager (Oakland, CA)
jobs.description:
Cross Country is looking for top talent to join our team! We are a market-leading, tech-enabled workforce solutions and advisory firm with more than four decades of experience helping organizations solve complex labor and operational challenges. Recognized as a Top Place to Work by U.S. News & World Report and a Most Loved Workplace by Newsweek, Cross Country is committed to quality and excellence in everything we deliver. We were also the first public company to earn The Joint Commission Gold Seal of Approval® for Health Care Staffing Services Certification with Distinction — a standard we continue to uphold today.
  
  
**BASIC PURPOSE:**  
The Sr Program Manager oversees day-to-day service delivery and performance for assigned PACE (Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly) program client. The role ensures accurate position management, timely caregiver and clinical placements, supplier engagement, and adherence to PACE regulatory and contract requirements. The Sr Program Manager serves as primary point of contact for client leaders and internal teams, driving fill rates, time-to-fill, and renewal/extension performance while maintaining exceptional customer service and compliance.
  
  
**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**  

* Own end-to-end position management for center personnel (create, intake, update, close) in client VMS/third-party systems and CCH technologies; ensure data integrity for KPIs (fill rate, time to fill, renewal rate, aging orders).
* Conduct thorough order intake with Hiring Managers to capture scope (participant needs, acuity, language, geographic coverage, shift, licensure, EVV, transportation) for center personnel.
* Maintain standardized position note templates specific to PACE/home care requirements.
* Match and submit qualified candidates to open requisitions for center personnel; review all profiles for quality and compliance before submission.
* Meet or exceed MSO SLAs (e.g., review/drop/submit within 4 business hours) and document outcomes for all submittals, interviews, offers, extensions, and declines for center personnel.
* Serve as day-to-day liaison for PACE leadership, clinical managers, schedulers, and finance; provide frequent status updates on openings, pipeline, and barriers.
* Proactively call facilities/centers to update needs, confirm extensions/renewals, and address urgent or crisis coverage (e.g., hospital discharges, participant safety concerns, flu/COVID surges).
* Coordinate assignment details (start dates, shifts, geography, mileage/drive time, planned time off).
* Distribute requisitions to supplier partners; drive supplier engagement and accountability to achieve coverage goals.
* Partner with internal recruiting, credentialing, compliance, and payroll; use a team to solve coverage gaps.
* Mentor and provide day-to-day direction to support staff (Staffing Specialist, Site Coordinators, and Branch leads) on process, systems, and PACE nuances.
* Ensure submissions and assignments meet PACE and state home care requirements (e.g., licensure, background, TB/fit testing where applicable, EVV, immunizations, driver/auto requirements).
* Escalate and resolve quality or participant-safety issues in partnership with client clinical leads and internal QA.
* Maintain meticulous documentation in line with audit standards.
* Produce weekly performance reporting (fill rate, time-to-fill, renewal rates, order aging, supplier performance) for client and leadership.
* Contribute to Quarterly/Annual Business Reviews (QBR/ABR), operational calls, and presentations with data-driven insights and action plans.
* Monitor production of aligned associates; verify coverage/back-up during absences and escalate risks timely.
* Negotiate assignment specifics with internal/external stakeholders within approved rate/contract frameworks; confirm terms (rates, shift, location radius, EVV, expenses).
* Drive prompt resolution of disputes, fall-offs, and schedule changes; document outcomes and preventive actions.
* Retain and grow assigned MSP PACE accounts through consistent, professional service delivery.
* May be required to provide after-hours, weekend, and holiday coverage based on business needs, ensuring timely coordination of staffing and effective communication with PACE program partners to maintain continuity of care.
* Other duties as assigned

**QUALIFICATIONS:**  

* 5+ years of account or program management experience in healthcare staffing within an MSP/MSO/VMS environment.
* Minimum 3 years of leadership experience required, in healthcare staffing, homecare, or a related field. 5 years preferred.
* Experience supporting PACE programs or home/community-based care (HCBS), including knowledge of state regulations, EVV, and credentialing preferred.
* Solid sales/negotiation acumen (rates, extensions, renewals) and supplier management experience preferred.
* Demonstrated success managing multi-disciplinary home care or post-acute staffing (caregivers and clinical roles) with measurable KPI improvements.
* Strong customer service and stakeholder management skills; proven ability to lead cross-functional, matrixed teams.
* Proficiency with VMS/third-party client systems and Microsoft Office; strong Excel/reporting skills.
* Clear, professional communication (written and verbal); strong organization, follow-through, and attention to detail.

**Education:** High School Diploma or equivalent required. Bachelor’s in Business, Healthcare Administration, or related field preferred or any equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential functions of the job.
  
  
Company equipment(laptop, monitor, keyboard, mouse headset) will be provided directly to you for use during employment.
  
  
Benefits
  
  
Cross Country offers a competitive compensation, benefits, and wellness program, including Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, Voluntary Insurance, 401(k) plan, Tuition

Department Summary
  
  
The Enterprise Engagement team helps create the conditions for coworkers to thrive and for teams to perform at their best. We connect coworker insights, culture, inclusion and belonging, and performance practices to strengthen the everyday coworker experience and help the organization deliver on its Purpose, Virtues, and Stands.
  
  
The team leads enterprise strategies and programs that shape and strengthen culture, including Joy at Work, Breakthrough, and Inclusion & Belonging. We use coworker listening, data, and insights to understand the experiences and mindsets influencing culture, identify opportunities for improvement, and help translate those insights into focused action.
  
  
Through enterprise programs, tools, and partnerships, the team helps leaders and teams strengthen connection, belonging, ownership, and performance; embed desired ways of working into the everyday coworker experience, and build the capabilities needed to turn culture into a driver of business outcomes.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Expert Business Operations - Effectiveness & Activation leads the operating system, governance, and execution discipline for Enterprise Engagement, ensuring strategic priorities translate into measurable actions and sustainable business outcomes. This role drives operational effectiveness through enterprise planning, KPI management, Lean operating practices, performance reviews, problem-solving, and cross-functional coordination.
  
  
Serving as a key integrator across Joy at Work, Breakthrough, and Inclusion & Belonging, this position connects enterprise priorities with functional area execution, strengthens accountability, and ensures alignment across Joy Councils, Centers of Excellence (COEs), and leadership teams. The role establishes the structure, processes, and operating rhythms needed to accelerate performance, remove barriers, and advance enterprise engagement and culture outcomes.
  
  
The role is hybrid working from your remote office and in-person at Oakland General Office, 1-2x weekly based on business needs.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
Lead development and maintenance of the Enterprise Engagement Plan on a Page, enterprise Joy KPI tree, and strategic priorities, translating objectives into actionable plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes. Establish processes to monitor performance, identify gaps, escalate risks, and ensure timely execution of priorities. Integrate Joy at Work, Breakthrough, and Inclusion & Belonging priorities into a cohesive enterprise engagement strategy and execution framework. Own and continuously improve the Enterprise Engagement operating system, including Lean adherence, visual management, standard work, and organizational maturity. Lead monthly operating reviews (MORs), enterprise Joy MORs, problem-solving cadence, office hours, and command center governance. Drive meeting effectiveness through strategic agendas, action tracking, accountability, and timely follow-through. Maintain visibility into key deliverables, timelines, dependencies, and performance improvement actions. Serve as the primary operational connection between enterprise engagement priorities and functional area execution, ensuring alignment, communication, and accountability. Coordinate partnership communications, leadership follow-up, and cross-functional action plans to address gaps and accelerate progress. Identify opportunities to integrate Joy at Work, Breakthrough, and Inclusion & Belonging efforts, enabling a coordinated and holistic approach to enterprise coworker engagement priorities. Evaluate the effectiveness of operating processes, governance structures, and engagement mechanisms, recommending improvements to strengthen execution and results. Apply Lean problem-solving methodologies and performance insights to identify barriers, drive corrective actions, and improve organizational effectiveness. Manage Enterprise Engagement budget planning, tracking, and resource coordination to support strategic priorities. Strengthen organizational discipline through clear ownership, consistent follow-through, and continuous improvement of enterprise engagement processes. May act as a team lead and provide direction to less experienced employees. Communicate complex ideas to diverse audiences using a variety of media.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
**Minimum:**  
Bachelor degree or equivalent work experience 8 years of related experience or equivalent
  
  
**Desired:**  
Demonstrates ability to lead multi/cross-functional teams in a matrix environment Inter-organizational management of complex, strategic projects Ability to influence leaders inside and outside of the department through data analysis, insights and recommendations Adept at addressing issues with diplomacy and tact

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. As a member of the Compute Capacity Strategy & Operations team, you will own initiatives that support Anthropic's compute capacity planning and management. ### **Founder-led marketing**

* Build and run the operating system for the CEO's marketing presence: content calendar, speaking and event schedule, media and podcast opportunities, and social channels.

* Coordinate data requests across Finance, Legal, and functional leaders, and check inputs for accuracy and consistency before review.

jobs.description:
The Senior Program Manager – Interiors and Clinical Environment Standards manages the development, governance, continuous improvement, and oversight of the UCSF Health Interiors and Clinical Environment Standards Program under the direction of the Health Major Capital Director of of Project Delivery and in collaboration with the UCSF Campus Architect. This role serves as the enterprise-wide subject matter expert for healthcare interiors, clinical environment planning, and design standards, influencing the planning and design of capital projects across UCSF Health.

  

A significant responsibility of this position is front-end planning for new outpatient clinics, hospitals, inpatient units, and other clinical care environments. Working with clinical and operational leadership, capital planning, architects, clinical planners, equipment planners, and other stakeholders, the Senior Program Manager helps translate models of care, operational requirements, patient and staff needs, and institutional priorities into physical planning and design criteria. Early involvement helps establish consistent planning principles before project-specific design solutions are developed.

  

The program encompasses interior design standards and standardized clinical planning criteria for inpatient and outpatient care environments, including clinical room templates, room configurations and layouts, equipment and furniture standards, casework and storage, interior finishes and materials, signage, art, and other elements of the built environment. Standards consider clinical workflow, equipment and technology integration, ergonomics, accessibility, infection prevention, safety, sustainability, maintainability, flexibility, patient experience, and efficient use of space.

  

The Senior Program Manager establishes the governance, policies, criteria, and processes through which these standards are developed, approved, applied, and updated. The role provides strategic oversight and subject matter expertise primarily during programming, planning, and design, working with project teams to promote consistency, reduce unnecessary variation, and appropriately apply enterprise standards while accommodating unique clinical and operational requirements.

  

The position establishes healthcare-specific criteria for finishes, furnishings, equipment, art, and signage based on clinical function, aesthetics, sustainability, durability, cleanability, infection prevention, regulatory and building code requirements, ergonomics, safety, lifecycle cost, and patient and staff experience. The role collaborates with architects, designers, furniture and equipment vendors, art consultants, and other industry professionals to develop solutions consistent with UCSF Health standards and its mission to provide advanced, effective, and human-centered healthcare environments.

  

Management of the program includes maintaining standards and clinical planning templates; establishing stakeholder and user-input processes; providing quality assurance during planning and design; reporting to appropriate governance structures; and administering a formal exception process when project-specific clinical, operational, regulatory, or physical conditions require deviation from established standards. The Senior Program Manager also works with established organizational partners and governance groups, including the Art Committee, Signage Committee, UCSF Interior Design Standards website development group, and University Development and Alumni Relations (UDAR) for donor recognition standards.

  

These responsibilities extend across UCSF Health's capital portfolio, including Health Major Capital Projects, Health Design and Construction Projects, and Health Small Projects. The program currently influences three approved major capital programs totaling approximately $7 billion, approximately 100 Health Design and Construction projects totaling $200 million, and approximately 150 Health Small Project work orders annually totaling $5 million. Through this enterprise-wide responsibility, the Senior Program Manager helps ensure UCSF Health facilities are planned around consistent, scalable standards that support clinical care, operational efficiency, patient experience, staff effectiveness, and long-term facility performance.

**THE ROLE:**

AMD is seeking a Senior Program Manager, Data Center Strategy & Planning to build and scale the processes, governance, and tools that underpin AMD's data center strategy and acquisition function. You possess strong organizational and analytical skills, a bias toward action, and the judgment to determine when processes need to be formalized versus kept lightweight. **PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:**

**Why Harvey**
==============

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

**Role Overview**
=================

We're hiring a GTM Onboarding Lead to own Global Onboarding within GTM Enablement. Harvey is hiring go-to-market talent faster than at any point in its history, and in 2027 the GTM organization will more than double across AMER, EMEA and APAC. Every one of those hires goes through onboarding. The program runs well in the US, is up and running in London and is about to launch in Sydney. This person will turn it into one global system, built for a hiring volume very few companies have had to onboard.

You will own role-specific ramp tracks, bootcamp cohorts, milestone certifications, 30/60/90 frameworks, ramp measurement, the LMS and content system, and the everboarding curriculum that keeps tenured reps current. You are accountable for one number above all: time to productivity for every GTM hire, everywhere.

This is a player/coach role, strategic and hands-on in equal measure. You will think about onboarding at global scale while writing curriculum, running cohorts and building the ramp dashboard yourself. You will also lead a small team of onboarding program managers in AMER and EMEA and set the standard that APAC delivers against.

  

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Turn the current onboarding program into one global system, deciding what is standard in every region and what each region adapts
* Design the cohort model and delivery capacity to absorb a doubling of GTM headcount in 2027 with quality intact, including where AI lets a small team run a large program
* Own ramp reporting and a common ramp standard for every role, find where ramp slips by role, region and cohort, and change the program to fix it
* Partner with Sales Productivity to connect AE ramp milestones to pipeline generation and attainment
* Own the architecture for role-specific tracks across AEs, BDRs, CSMs, Legal Engineers, LEPS and Solutions Architects, and build the most important ones yourself
* Own frontline manager onboarding and the everboarding curriculum that keeps tenured reps current as our product, pricing and methodology change
* Own LMS strategy, the move to an AI-native LMS, certification infrastructure and the content system
* Lead, coach and develop the onboarding program managers in AMER and EMEA and the contractors who support delivery
* Partner with our APAC enablement lead so hires in Sydney get the same program as everyone else

**What You Have**
=================

* 8+ years of experience in enablement, onboarding, learning and development, or GTM program leadership at a high-growth technology company, ideally including time in a sales seat
* 2+ years managing a team (small teams count), with people you developed and held to a clear standard
* Recent hands-on experience building and delivering onboarding curriculum, certifications or ramp programs yourself
* A track record of owning a GTM onboarding or ramp program end to end, at scale, with measurable impact on time to productivity
* Experience running programs across multiple regions, with a clear point of view on what should be global and what should be local
* Comfort with data, including building and defending a ramp dashboard and changing the program when the numbers say to
* Strong operating instincts across governance, stakeholder rhythms, capacity planning and measurement, ideally sharpened somewhere fast-moving
* Credibility with sales, CS and technical leaders, including the ability to hold a hard conversation about why a cohort is behind
* Willingness to travel to London, Sydney and our other US hub about twice a year
* Bonus: familiarity with a structured sales methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or similar) and with LMS and certification platforms

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in program or project management.
* Experience in Supply Chain Management.
* Experience with Lean Six Sigma, Kaizen, or structured root cause analysis methodologies.

* 2 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Experience with artificial intelligence to generate data scripts, analysis, and reports.
* Experience with system design.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

This role is at a crucial balance point between Demand and Supply to ensure that Google has the right amount of machine learning infrastructure to meet the needs of product areas.  
  
You will collaborate with all organizational levels to define project requirements for new processes and software systems, coordinate with cross-functional teams to drive decision making, and plan for scalable, efficient, and predictable growth. You will use your analytical skills to establish and drive metrics, drive process and system improvements to accomplish efficiency and scalability goals and directly support our rapidly growing machine learning infrastructure at our global data centers.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $132000 - $189000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop short and long-term supply and demand model that seek to maximize supply output while also balancing inventories and critically constrained parts.
* Establish and utilize best methods (statistical models, processes and software tools) in evaluating supply chain’s ability to meet customer demand.
* Develop and communicate policies/methodologies for any supply allocations.
* Lead demand and supply planning meetings with cross-functional teams, reviewing supply, demand risks/mitigation options/service level goals.
* Prepare, report, and present Supply and Demand recommendations with sound models and logic to leadership, drive timely decisions, and ensure clear and concise communication to all stakeholders in the supply chain.
