**About Bill Wilson Center:**  
Bill Wilson Center provides services to children, youth, young adults, and families in Santa Clara County. Additionally, we reach clients through our street outreach and crisis line programs. Bill Wilson Center programs focus on housing, mental health care, supportive services, and advocacy. Bill Wilson Center is committed to working with the community to ensure that every youth has access to the range of services needed to grow to be healthy and self-sufficient adults. A key component of Bill Wilson Center's philosophy encompasses a strength-based approach to improving the lives of the youth and young families in our communities. Bill Wilson Center has been providing services to runaway and homeless youth since 1973. Join us and become a difference maker at Bill Wilson Center!

**Job Summary:**  
The Site Operation Program Manager is an important part of the Enhanced Short-Term Residential Therapeutic Program (E-STRTP) management team supporting the agency mission and vision to help our most vulnerable population of foster youth achieve self-sufficiency and life skills needed towards reaching their unique hopes and dreams. This program serves up to 2 vulnerable youth (ages 10-17) within the foster care or juvenile justice systems who require intensive, trauma-informed therapeutic care. Through holistic, positive youth development practices, we help youth stabilize during crises and build the skills to resolve conflict and navigate developmental milestones using their own strengths, family relationships, and support networks The Site Operation Program Manager ensures strict day-to-day legal and operational compliance with Title 22 licensing standards, while leading a team of Youth Care Counselors to ensure day to day operations are up to Community Care Licensing (CCL) standards.

**Essential Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Provide on-going supervision to direct service staff
* Interview, coach, and develop staff professional development plans, 6 month and annual performance plans, as well as quarterly OKRs.
* Manage all scheduling of employees and maintain adequate ratios of staff to youth.
* Maintain budgetary responsibilities and management within approved guidelines. Maintain census to meet budget projections
* Attend quarterly collaborative meeting with DFCS, and monthly Agency PQI and Program Ops Meetings
* Ensure that all employees complete initial (40 hrs.) and continuing (20 hrs./yr.) education requirements
* Monthly review of outcome metrics and program development/interventions to support meeting all outcomes
* Facilitate weekly staff meetings and clinical reviews
* Review all incident reports written by staff within one business day of occurrence and send to CCL and Placement worker
* Ensure staff are meeting client documentation expectations and deadlines
* Conduct Performance Evaluations of Staff
* Provide or designate on-call support 24/7 for all programs and assist with crisis intervention.
* Oversee that medication procedures are followed in accordance to CCL requirements.
* Crisis Intervention support
* Develop relationships with County Social Services, police departments, community CBO’s and other potential partners for placement, referrals and coordination of services
* Data entry of all client contacts and outcomes in AWARDs electronic health care record
* Ability to make sound clinical assessments and interventions with challenging youth behaviors and mental health issues
* Frequent evaluation and assessment of youth’s physical, psychological and emotional needs

* Participation in CFT’s,TDM’s and MyTime meetings

* Encourage and develop plan with youth to support their well-being and increase lifelong connections with supportive caring adults

* Ensure that site is neat and tidy and report all maintenance or safety issues to manger or Facilities Manager immediately

-----------------

**Cuttable exists because creativity shouldn’t be what slows marketing teams down.**

The world’s biggest advertising platforms demand more ads than most teams can produce. But production is still slow, expensive and built for a different era. Briefs pile up. Creative teams burn out. Marketers can’t keep up.

Cuttable fixes that.

We’re an AI Creative Production System that helps ecommerce brands create, test and launch ads across Meta, TikTok and Google at the volume the platforms actually reward.

More than 300 brands across North America and Asia Pacific already use Cuttable. We’re backed by Square Peg, Rampersand and AirTree, following one of the largest seed rounds in Australian tech history. Offices in Melbourne and New York.

Our CEO and co-founder, Sam Kroonenburg, has built and scaled a global technology company before. Now we’re doing it again.

**Join us and help make good ads, instantly.**

### **The role**

**Pay range: $101,000 – $151,000 USD per year** — the range we reasonably expect to pay for this role at hire.

As Cuttable scales its US customer base, our customers need someone who owns their success long after onboarding. As a Customer Success Manager, you’ll own retention, adoption and expansion across a book of US customers from day 90 onward, including every renewal in that book. You’ll be the trusted advisor customers call for ideas, not just support, and you’ll treat retention and growth as your number, acting independently and never waiting for permission to save or grow an account.

You’ll report to the Customer Success Director and partner day to day with Implementation, Sales, Product and Support. This role is based in San Francisco, in the office at least 2 days per week (hybrid).

**What you’ll own**

* Retention, adoption and expansion across a book of US customers from day 90 onward, including every renewal.
* The customer relationship after the day-90 handover from Implementation.
* Account health across your book: using usage, health and engagement data to spot at-risk renewals early and act before they land.
* Your number: hitting or beating your renewal and expansion quota once it is set in Q1 2027.

**What you’ll drive**

* Product adoption and expansion (more brands, more users, bigger plans and more of customers’ spend on Cuttable creative) by tying Cuttable to the numbers they care about, like ROAS and CPA.
* Expansion conversations that lead with value, not a pitch, starting from the customer’s goals and results.
* Business reviews and success plans that make the value obvious to decision-makers at every level, from paid social leads to CMOs.
* Customer advocacy: referrals, case studies and champions inside customer teams.
* Smart prioritisation, so multi-brand teams and fast-moving single brands each get the attention that matches what’s at stake.
* Improvements to our renewal and expansion playbook, contributing what’s working in your book as we build the motion in the US.

**Who you’ll support**

* Implementation Managers, by agreeing a clean day-90 handover so customers never feel the change of owner.
* Account Executives, by flagging expansion opportunities and sharing account context ahead of commercial conversations.
* Product, by sharing customer feedback, feature requests and patterns you see across your book.
* Newer team members, through informal mentoring, coaching and empathetic feedback.
* The Customer Success Director, with input on how CSM quotas and variable comp should be measured.

**What success looks like at six months**

* Customers are using more of Cuttable (more brands, more users, more of their spend on Cuttable creative) because you tied it to the numbers they care about, like ROAS and CPA.
* Revenue across your book is growing, and you saw at-risk renewals coming well before they landed.
* Customers call you for advice, not just support. You bring ideas before they ask and do what you say you’ll do.
* Your time matches what’s at stake: multi-brand teams and fast-moving single brands each get the attention they need.
* Your best customers are your best pipeline, referring peers, joining case studies and championing Cuttable inside their own teams.
* You’re on track to hit or exceed your quota from Q1 2027, and you’ve contributed to a renewal and expansion playbook the team uses.

### **Who we look for**

We hire for values as much as experience, because mindset carries you through the parts no job description can predict. Here’s what that looks like day to day at Cuttable:

* **Be Brave & Own It**: you take smart risks and you own what happens next, good or bad. You own the outcome, not just the intention.
* **Create Customer Magic**: you listen hard enough to get to what customers actually need, not just what they said.
* **Say It (With Care)**: You say the honest thing, directly, and with genuine care for the person hearing it.
* **Progress Beats Perfection**: you’d rather ship, learn, and improve than sit on something waiting for it to be flawless.
* **Work Hard, Laugh Often**: you take the work seriously. Never yourself.

We believe you’ll succeed in this role if you have:

* Demonstrated experience as a Customer Success Manager, Account Manager or Account Executive in B2B SaaS, with a track record of growing revenue through renewals, expansion and product adoption, and of hitting or beating your number.
* Experience managing a mix of account sizes, from fast-moving brands to multi-stakeholder teams, and the ability to build trust with decision-makers at every level, from paid social leads to CMOs.
* Strong storytelling: business reviews and success plans that make the value obvious.
* A data-driven way of running your book. Usage, health and engagement tell you where to focus, and you know when to pull in peers or the Customer Success Director for help.
* Comfort using tools like HubSpot, Intercom (or similar), Notion, Loom and Slack.
* Bonus: working knowledge of performance ma

---------------

Are you interested in helping to shape the era of Artificial Intelligence (AI)? AI is transforming entire industries and fundamentally changing the way we live and work. AWS is positioned at the forefront of GenAI with the deepest set of services and features as the leader in cloud.  
  
  
  
  
As a Senior Account Manager for Startups at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will be the strategic lead responsible for driving cloud adoption within a group of stellar startups at the forefront of machine learning development.
  
  
AWS offers a complete set of cloud services that enable all companies, from startups to enterprises, to run virtually everything in the cloud, including application development, model training, big data analytics, and AI/ML platforms.  
  
  
  
  
Frontier Startups, represent a critically important subset of customers to AWS. These companies have unique needs, technical considerations, sales cycles, and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional companies. As AWS continues to rapidly grow, we seek a Frontier Startup Account Manager to earn trust and help drive growth amongst a set of well-funded, high-potential startups.  
  
  
  
  
The ideal candidate possesses a strong sales acumen, knowledge of the startup ecosystem, a passion for (and familiarity with) machine learning and frontier technology trends. You will be working with startups building cutting edge AI and ML solutions, so extensive collaboration with external contacts and internal teams will be key to build and execute on plans to meet and exceed sales quota. Your responsibilities will include driving revenue, gaining executive buy in and alignment, accelerating innovation through service adoption, and ensuring these startups select AWS as their primary cloud provider.  
  
  
  
  
You will align closely with counterparts in business development, marketing, solution architecture, and partner teams to lead execution of coordinated go-to-market strategies and sales plays. You will also work closely with business development teams who are driving strategic support, global co-programming, and portfolio engagement to help drive top-of-funnel customer acquisition and accelerate seller cycles in the field.  
  
  
  
  
Candidates will be working with startups building cutting edge AI and ML solutions and should have a good understanding of machine learning technologies and how startups are using them to enhance services and processes for end customers. The ideal candidate will have a strong entrepreneurial spirit who is prepared to work in a fast-paced, often ambiguous environment, execute against ambitious goals, and consistently embrace the Amazon Culture.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Prospect, Scope, Develop, and Close complex, multi-dimensional deals involving technology, go-to-market packages, and programs
  
  
Align with customer success criteria to deliver value early (mid to late stage startups)
  
  
Drive revenue and market share in a defined territory or industry vertical
  
  
Accelerate customer adoption of AWS services through well-developed sales engagements and successful GTM Strategy
  
  
Meet or exceed quarterly revenue and goal targets
  
  
Develop and execute against a comprehensive account/territory plan.

Successfully work in a large-scale environment, leading collaboration with AWS resources (Solution Architects, Business Development, Marketing, Partners, Support, and Service teams) to drive customer solution adoption at scale.  
  
  
  
  
About the team  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
  
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
  
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
  
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. The OMT is responsible for engaging in and owning their professional development through completing the OM Development Program while being supported by their direct supervisor. This will be done in a variety of ways: through structured curriculum completion, on the job practical application and development meetings. The OMT role is hired with the expectations that each individual will be able to independently manage a dental office in 4-6 months, following timely completion of the OM Development Program.

**Responsibilities**

jobs.title: Business Operations Lead
jobs.description:
### **The Bigger Picture**

At Andromeda, we're building the social intelligence layer for humanoid robots - technology that allows robots to understand people, build relationships and become a meaningful part of everyday life.

Our first robot, Abi, is already doing this in aged care and healthcare, where she brings conversation, companionship and engagement to people every day.

Now we're scaling from early deployments into a platform that can operate across thousands of real-world environments. We're looking for individuals who want to tackle hard problems across robotics and AI, and help define what it means for robots to live and interact alongside people.

### **About the role**

You'll be a high-trust generalist who works directly with the COO on the company's hardest and least-defined problems. One week you'll be standing up a new process for tracking Abi fleet health. Another week you’ll be automating a task multiple teams do by hand. And another week you might be standing up a new function.

You'll own projects end to end with a lot of autonomy and visibility. You will work across every function, from engineering and manufacturing to commercial and finance.

### **What you’ll do**

**Put AI to work on operations**

* Spot repetitive or high-volume work that AI can handle, then build, test, and ship agents and workflows (Claude preferred) that teams use every day.
* Turn what we learn from customers and operations into reusable templates and repeatable workflows.
* Be the go-to person for teams adopting AI tools in their daily work, and provide training and enablement.

**Give leadership a clear view of the business**

* Decide which numbers matter, then build and maintain the metrics and dashboards leadership uses to run the company.
* Support the planning rhythm: quarterly OKRs, leadership reviews, and the data going into board and investor updates.
* Dig into trends and anomalies to explain what is happening and why, and recommend what to do about it.

**Take problems from fuzzy to finished**

* Take ambiguous problems from scoping through business case, planning, execution, reporting, enablement, and impact tracking.
* Spot gaps, bottlenecks, and opportunities before they become obvious, and fix them with practical solutions as we scale.
* Step into whatever the business needs next, including work outside your comfort zone.

**Improve processes and drive adoption**

* Map how work really flows between teams, find the waste, and design simpler processes and tooling.
* Write down what you build so it outlasts you, and then train people on it.
* Roll out changes thoughtfully, check whether people are using them, and measure whether they helped.

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years in management consulting, investment banking, strategic finance, or business operations at a high-growth, start-up technology company.
* A track record of owning complex, multi-stakeholder projects to completion on tight timelines, with little supervision.
* Strong analytical foundation: comfortable pulling, cleaning, and modeling data (spreadsheets, SQL or similar, and a BI/dashboarding tool) to drive decisions.
* Hands-on experience building AI agents or workflows, ideally with Claude, and running and improving them in real use.
* Clear communication with both technical and non-technical audiences, and the ability to influence senior leaders.
* High tolerance for ambiguity, context-switching, and intensity. Exceptional performance in whatever you've pursued.
* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business field, or equivalent experience. MBA or other advanced degree preferred.

  
**Benefits**

Andromeda Robotics is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. We are also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities.

The expected base salary for this role is $155,000 to $200,000 plus Benefits and Equity.

Please note: We do not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

**Our Values**

* **Empathy** – Kindness and compassion are at the heart of everything we do.
* **Play** – Play sharpens focus. It keeps us curious, fast and obsessed with the craft.
* **Never Settle** – A relentless ambition, bias toward action, and uncomfortable levels of curiosity.
* **Tenacity** – Tenacious under pressure, we assume chaos and stay in motion to adapt and progress.
* **Unity** – Different minds. Shared mission. No passengers.

**Let’s build the future together.**

jobs.title: Senior People Partner
jobs.description:
### **About Niantic Spatial**

We are building for the >80% of economic activity that happens beyond the reach of screens. AI has learned from the text, images and video online, but it still lacks an accurate understanding of physical space. That's one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it's the one we're solving at Niantic Spatial.

We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That's why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world's most widely used maps. Now we're building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

### **The Role**

We are looking for a Senior People Partner who combines strong business judgment with hands-on execution. Reporting to the Chief People Officer, you will own People partnership for the business, with a particular focus on engineering and technical teams.

This is a player-coach role on a lean People team. You will coach managers and leaders, strengthen team effectiveness, and personally deliver the work required to turn decisions into action. On any given day, you might help a leader clarify team responsibilities, guide a manager through a performance issue, resolve an employee concern, or use AI to simplify a recurring workflow.

You will independently manage day-to-day People priorities, partnering with the Chief People Officer on broader organizational decisions and particularly complex or sensitive matters. You will also lead defined People programs and projects that support the company’s priorities.

You should understand how engineers work, build credibility with technical leaders, and bring practical experience helping teams perform through ambiguity and change. You are AI-forward in your own work and help others adopt better ways of working.

### **What You’ll Do**

**Partner with leaders to build effective teams**

* Translate business priorities into practical people plans for your groups, including staffing needs, team structure, manager capability, and development.
* Partner with Engineering, Research, Product, and other leaders to understand how their teams operate, identify barriers to execution, and improve effectiveness.
* Help leaders clarify roles, responsibilities, and decision ownership as priorities evolve.
* Surface emerging people and organizational issues early, recommend solutions, and follow through on agreed actions.
* Partner with the Chief People Officer on organizational planning and decisions with broader company implications.

**Coach managers and strengthen accountability**

* Help managers set clear expectations, give direct feedback, address underperformance, and recognize strong contributions.
* Coach managers and leaders on delegation, prioritization, communication, and leading through uncertainty.
* Guide performance reviews, talent discussions, and development planning for your groups, ensuring decisions lead to clear actions and follow-through.
* Help managers maintain a high bar for quality, ownership, collaboration, and speed.
* Build and deliver practical tools and guidance that strengthen everyday management.

**Execute organizational change**

* Help leaders plan and implement team changes, including role clarity, manager preparation, employee communication, and follow-up.
* Support the evolution of working practices as we move from technical exploration toward repeatable customer and business outcomes.
* Identify where unclear ownership, slow decisions, or unnecessary process is limiting progress and work with leaders to address it.
* Use employee feedback and people data to identify patterns, recommend specific actions, and assess progress.

**Own the day-to-day People partnership**

* Serve as a trusted resource for employees and managers, handling sensitive situations with sound judgment, discretion, and care.
* Manage employee relations matters and conduct investigations, partnering with the Chief People Officer and counsel as appropriate.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition and hiring managers on role definition, hiring priorities, candidate assessment, and onboarding.
* Collaborate with Total Rewards on compensation, leveling, promotions, and retention recommendations.
* Own case management, documentation, and follow-through, bringing in additional expertise when needed.
* Contribute to the broader People team by sharing practical approaches and helping colleagues solve problems.

**Improve People programs and use AI to increase effectiveness**

* Lead defined People programs and improvement projects from planning through implementation, coordinating stakeholders and tracking results.
* Use AI tools regularly to accelerate research, analysis, drafting, and workflow improvement, reviewing outputs for accuracy and usefulness and exercising care with sensitive information.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive work and create more capacity for manager and employee support.
* Help managers translate changes in AI capabilities into practical development needs and clearer expectations for their teams.
* Use HR systems, people data, and business context to inform recommendations and reduce manual work.
* Build processes that are easy to use and appropriate for our stage.

### **What You Bring**

* Typically eight or more years of progressive People experience, including significant experience as a People Partner or HR Business Partner.
* Direct experience supporting engineering

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager - Incident Coordinator
jobs.description:
About GitHub: GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.  
Locations: In this role you can work from Remote, United States  
Overview:

GitHub is seeking an experienced and customer-focused Senior Program Manager-Incident Coordinator to independently coordinate complex, high-risk and business-critical customer situations within the Incident Coordination team’s remit.

Senior Program Manager-Incident Coordinator provides leadership during urgent customer-impacting incidents, creating clarity in ambiguous situations, establishing ownership and aligning Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Reliability Engineering, Customer Success and other stakeholders around a clear path forward.

This role requires excellent judgement, composure and the ability to influence without direct authority. The Senior Program Manager-Incident Coordinator must be able to manage several competing workstreams, make explicit prioritization decisions and communicate complex technical situations clearly to customers, senior leaders and technical stakeholders.

The role extends beyond coordinating individual incidents. Senior Program Manager-Incident Coordinators use evidence from incidents and escalations to identify recurring risks, recommend improvements and deliver agreed changes within the incident coordination remit. They partner with accountable teams on broader product, support-process and customer-experience improvements.

Success is measured through effective incident coordination, sound prioritisation, timely and accurate customer communication, reliable handovers and follow-through on agreed actions. The role also contributes to shared improvements that reduce repeat customer impact, avoidable urgent demand and preventable executive escalations.

Responsibilities:

Strategic incident leadership

* Independently lead complex, high-risk customer incidents, prioritising by impact, urgency and risk.

* Create clarity and momentum when cause, ownership, recovery path or customer outcome is uncertain.

* Own coordination, communication, action tracking and handovers across the incident lifecycle.

* Establish clear technical ownership and coordinate workstreams, decisions, risks, dependencies and next steps. Engineering and Support remain accountable for technical decisions, remediation and resource commitments.

* Exercise sound judgement, challenge assumptions and adapt the response as evidence changes.

* Make competing priorities and trade-offs explicit, engaging specialist support or accountable leaders when needed.

Cross-functional leadership and influence

* Bring together the required internal teams and Microsoft partners to coordinate an effective response.

* Align stakeholders with different priorities, responsibilities and perspectives.

* Influence technical owners, senior stakeholders and partners without relying on direct authority.

* Resolve unclear ownership, identify alternative paths and escalate proportionately while maintaining productive relationships.

* Drive timely decisions, confirm accountable owners and track actions, risks and dependencies to completion.

* Act as a trusted operational adviser during executive-visible and high-pressure situations.

Customer and executive communication

* Translate complex technical information into concise, accurate and business-relevant updates.

* Separate confirmed facts from hypotheses, risks and unknowns.

* Set an effective communication cadence and tailor detail to each audience.

* Avoid speculation, unsupported recovery estimates and unrealistic commitments.

* Provide coordination and clarity on customer calls, managing expectations and supporting de-escalation.

* Lead difficult conversations while balancing customer advocacy with technical and operational constraints.

* Maintain stakeholder confidence while protecting responders from unnecessary distraction.

Incident intelligence and repeat-failure reduction

* Identify recurring patterns and systemic risks across incidents, customers, products and processes.

* Use evidence to define clear problems, insights and recommendations.

* Lead post-incident reviews focused on ownership, prevention and operational improvement.

* Agree corrective and preventative actions, owners and expected outcomes with accountable teams.

* Track significant actions to completion, acceptance or formal disposition, escalating stalled or unowned risks.

* Evaluate whether improvements reduce repeat incidents, customer impact and avoidable escalations.

Organisational and operational improvement

* Lead incident-coordination improvement projects and partner with accountable teams to implement agreed changes.

* Use incident and customer-impact evidence to influence product, engineering and operational priorities.

* Improve coordination processes, tooling, ownership, communication, handovers and disengagement practices.

* Identify automation and AI opportunities that increase consistency, effectiveness and scale.

* Develop outcome measures that show customer impact, operational risk and improvement progress.

* Create reusable operating practices, clarify ownership and share learning with partner teams.

Capability building

* Build and apply expertise across incident workflows and relevant product areas to clarify customer impact and support investigation.

* Train and onboard coordinators, sharing judgement and learning from complex incidents.

* Review incident communications, handovers and escalations to improve quality and consistency.

* Create reusable playbooks, standards and guidance that strengthen team capability without creating dependency on individuals.

* Share learning with Support and partner teams to improve incident read

The Provider Enrollment Specialist works in conjunction with the Provider Enrollment Manager to identify Provider Payer Enrollment issues or denials. This position is responsible for researching, resolving, and enrolling any payer issues, utilizing a variety of proprietary and external tools. This will require contacting clients, operations personnel, and Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) via phone, email, or website.

* **Reporting and Documentation:** Maintain accurate records, documentation, and audit trails of provider enrollment activities. Generate reports, analyze data, and track key performance indicators to monitor compliance, identify trends, and support decision-making.

Education and Experience Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree in any related field.

jobs.description:
**About Dutchie**

Founded in 2017, Dutchie is an all-in-one technology platform powering the cannabis industry with **Point of Sale**, **E-commerce**, **Payments**, and **Loyalty & Marketing**. Through our technology, we’re helping cannabis businesses start, operate, and grow with confidence.

With software that simplifies their operations, our customers can focus on what matters most—bringing the benefits of cannabis safely to consumers.

Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue. Powering thousands of dispensaries across 40+ markets throughout the United States and Canada, Dutchie is the leading technology company in the cannabis space and was named in Fast Company’s 10 Most Innovative Companies in North America and listed two years in a row on LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups.

Dutchie has raised over $600M in funding to date, backed by D1 Capital Partners, Tiger Global, Dragoneer, DFJ Growth, Thrive Capital, Howard Schultz, Snoop Dogg’s Casa Verde Capital, Gron Ventures, members of the founding team at DoorDash, Kevin Durant’s Thirty Five Ventures, and other notable angel investors.

Dutchie is the leading technology platform powering the cannabis industry. Our Brands team is the connective tissue between cannabis brands and the thousands of dispensaries that carry, merchandise, and advertise their products. You will work side by side with our Ad Sales team, who are the primary drivers of new business and expansion, and your work supports those efforts.

You will also use AI tools every day to work faster, from analysis to automation, and apply careful human judgment to everything they produce. Success requires someone who is self-sufficient, commercially minded, has strong attention to detail and comfortable owning a book of business.

* Own onboarding for new advertising customers from handoff by the Ad Sales team through go-live, translating each brand’s goals, budget, and target markets into a campaign strategy and launch plan with clear milestones.
* Configure and traffic campaigns in Kevel, including flights, targeting, creative, budgets, bids, and pacing, with careful quality control at every step, using AI and automation where they save time.

* Adjust bids, budgets, targeting, and creative with a portfolio-level view, accounting for the downstream effects across competing campaigns and shared inventory.

* Analyze campaign, Share of Voice, and sales-impact data, using AI tools to move faster and your own judgment to verify the results, and turn it into a clear narrative that explains performance in terms of the customer’s business outcomes.
* Use data-backed recommendations to influence strategic changes, such as shifts in budget, targeting, or promotional timing, and equip the Ad Sales team with the analysis they need to drive upsell and expansion.

The Field Operations & Enablement Manager makes FireMon's field team faster, more consistent, and better prepared in every customer and partner conversation. You'll own two connected areas: the operating rhythm of the field (process, data, forecasting, and tools) and the enablement program that gets sellers, sales engineers, and partners ready to win.

Why this role exists: Our best sellers win through sharper strategy, not more activity. This role spreads that edge across the whole field by turning deal insight, market knowledge, and commercial judgment into repeatable plays, coaching, and programs.

### **Responsibilities**

**Field** **O****perations**

* Drive adoption of the core field tech stack (Salesforce, sales engagement, Gong, deal registration, and content tools), working with the Salesforce Admin on the workflow and process changes that go-to-market (GTM) strategy, product launches, and pricing updates require.

* Design and maintain territory, account, and partner assignments with Sales and Channel leadership.

* Support the field operating cadence: forecast and pipeline reviews, territory and account planning, QBRs, sales kickoff, and regional meetings, including logistics.

* Build KPI dashboards and reports for the sales team on bookings, pipeline coverage, win rates, deal velocity, and partner-sourced revenue.

* Standardize deal desk inputs, including quoting (CPQ), approvals, and handoffs to Finance and CX.

* Analyze win/loss patterns, pricing outcomes, and field feedback, and bring data-backed findings to Product Marketing and Product Management.

* Sharpen ideal customer profiles (ICPs), account tiering, and target account plays, and find whitespace in the existing customer base.

**Sales** **E****nablement**

* Build and run a structured onboarding program that gets new sellers to first qualified pipeline within 90 days, backed by level-up learning and 1:1 or small-group sessions.

* Create a role-based training curriculum covering FireMon products, the security policy management market, buyer personas, discovery, and competitive positioning, with certification and ongoing reinforcement on core messaging, demos, and qualification methodology (for example, MEDDPICC).

* Partner with Product Marketing to turn GTM strategy, product launches, pricing and messaging updates, and win/loss findings into field-ready playbooks, value narratives, battlecards, and talk tracks.

* Extend enablement to channel partners through partner onboarding, certification paths, and co-selling resources.

* Own the sales content platform (such as Highspot or GTM Buddy): organize content by sales stage, persona, and use case, retire outdated assets, and track usage and deal influence so reps find current, approved material in under a minute.

* Partner with Sales leadership on deal and call reviews using Gong) and other GTM techs, track skill gaps, and measure enablement impact against ramp time, win rate, and quota attainment, adjusting programs based on what the data shows.

### **Required Skills and Experience**

* 5+ years in sales operations, revenue operations, or sales enablement at a B2B software company, with at least 2 years owning programs end to end.

* Hands-on Salesforce experience building reports, dashboards, and pipeline and forecast processes, plus the analytical judgment to turn messy data into a decision and a plan.

* A track record of building onboarding or training programs that measurably shortened ramp time or lifted win rates.

* Experience supporting enterprise sales motions with long cycles and multiple stakeholders.

* Strong facilitation and presentation skills, comfortable in front of sellers, sales engineers, and product teams and executives.

* Hands-on CPQ, Salesforce and enablement platform experience.

* Experience defining ideal customer profiles, account segmentation, or target account programs.

### **Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Background in cybersecurity, network security, or infrastructure software.

* Experience in a channel-led or partner-transacted sales model.

* Familiarity with MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or a similar methodology, and tools such as 6sense, Highspot, GTM Buddy, and ZoomInfo.

* Experience building playbooks and programs that change field behavior in a high-growth environment.

The Global Project Management team at Cerba Research is looking for a Project Manager to be the main point of contact for our clients after study award. We combine the scientific depth and agility of a specialist with the capacity and global reach of a central lab, with an accredited laboratory network across the US, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Australia and Africa. Real Ownership - Your studies, your sponsors, end to end.  
Client Facing - Lead client meetings, investigator meetings and bid defences.  
Room to Shape - Help improve how we work as our processes evolve.

Delivering studies on time, on scope and on budget

Sharing lessons learned and mentoring newer PMs

**About Cat5 Resources LLC**

Cat5 Resources is a diversified supplier of technical and operational services across the Southern US, Puerto Rico, and the US Virgin Islands.

In 2004, when Hurricane Charley devastated Florida, our CEO, Cindy Perez, received an out-of-the-blue call from a long-term telecom client in urgent need of help. Their other vendors could not deliver, so they turned to Cindy for assistance. She responded without hesitation, mobilizing a fleet of generators and emergency fuel to ensure the client’s critical infrastructure remained operational throughout the event.

In 2013, Cindy founded Cat5 Resources with a mission to provide reliable and innovative solutions for critical infrastructure resiliency. Since then, the Cat5 Resources team has consistently delivered exceptional customer service to clients nationwide. Over the years, Cat5 Resources has expanded its offerings to include Disaster Recovery Services, Operations and Maintenance, Civil, Electrical, and Construction, as well as Transportation and Logistics.

As a certified Woman-Owned Business, Cat5 Resources serves the entire Southern United States. In 2016, we extended our services into Puerto Rico with the launch of Cat5 Caribbean, focusing on critical infrastructure support in disaster-prone regions. jobs.title: Product Risk Program Manager - Product Enablement
jobs.description:
The Product Enablement (PE) team sits within Meta's Product Risk & Compliance organization and partners with Product Groups (PGs) at the earliest stages of development to steward end-to-end risk reviews.As a Product Risk Program Manager (PRPM), you will apply program management expertise and systems thinking to manage complex risk reviews from start to finish, enabling compliant product launches. You'll work hands-on with product and engineering teams to guide them through Meta's Risk Review process, while collaborating closely with legal, policy, engineering, and tooling partners to deliver a high-quality risk review experience, optimize processes, and build trust with internal and external stakeholders.  
  
  

### **Product Risk Program Manager - Product Enablement Responsibilities:**

* Support and manage the early product development support process to optimize Meta's Product Groups experience with Risk Review
* Proactively identify and resolve blockers, escalate issues, and remediate pain points
* Drive execution and accountability through clear communication, action tracking, and decision forums
* Establish expertise across an end to end system that's focused on reviewing and mitigating product risks
* Serve as a trusted advisor to product, engineering, and cross-functional teams, enabling them to navigate the Risk Review process efficiently and effectively
* Ensure project details & risk details are well documented, tracked, and resolved with transparency and consistency
* Establish and maintain coordinated relationships with Product, Legal, Policy, and Engineering to align on priorities, ensure process adherence, drive continuous system improvement, and ensure reviews are processed with appropriate depth and speed
* Provide guidance and support for supplemental risk assessments and research compliance reviews
* Partner with Specialized Assessment (SA) and Assurance Assessment (AA) Product Risk Program Managers to ensure the appropriate product context is captured within the Risk Review system and support Product Groups through the triage & escalation and audit & remediation processes

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 7+ years of experience in program management, product operations, trust & safety, privacy, compliance or in a related field
* Proven track record of managing projects with tight timelines and high ambiguity, involving multiple stakeholders
* Communication and cross-functional alignment skills, capable of tailoring clear, concise, and actionable messages across audiences (stakeholders, teams, executives) to navigate complex tradeoffs and ensure shared understanding
* Stakeholder management experience, including building relationships across functions and aligning diverse teams toward shared objectives and an ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional environment, building relationships and sharing knowledge to achieve shared objectives
* Demonstrated success in influencing across functions and without formal authority, gaining buy-in, inspiring trust, facilitating collaboration, and driving change
* Experience re-prioritizing work and adjusting plans in response to changing business needs, stakeholder input, or shifting timelines
* Experience proactively identifying and resolving blockers, escalating issues, and remediating pain points

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience applying analytical and problem-solving skills to improve processes or resolve complex issues
* Experience in managing cross-functional projects and teams
* Experience in leveraging AI and data-driven insights to continuously improve the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of a process
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. jobs.description:
**About Megaport**

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

**Our Team Culture**

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.

We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

The RevOps Program Manager, Alliances & Partnerships is responsible for building, operating, measuring, and continuously improving the operational infrastructure that connects Megaport's partner ecosystem to its global go-to-market organization.

This role bridges Alliance Partner Operations, Revenue Operations, and cross-functional Program Management. It combines hands-on execution of partner referrals, co-sell opportunity management, partner-system administration, and pipeline alignment with ownership of the processes, reporting, governance, and improvement programs that make partner-driven revenue scalable and measurable.

The position serves as a central operational connection point between external alliance ecosystems and Megaport's internal Sales, Marketing, Finance, Product, Legal, Customer Success, and Revenue Technology teams. It ensures that partner-originated and partner-influenced opportunities are accurately captured, routed to the appropriate internal teams, actively maintained across relevant systems, and measured throughout the revenue lifecycle.

Working with Alliance Leadership and GTM executives, the role translates partner-program requirements into practical operating procedures, reliable data flows, clear accountability, and actionable business intelligence. It supports joint selling motions, cloud marketplace transactions, partner-funded investments, and ecosystem development by reducing operational friction and improving visibility into partner contribution.

The successful candidate is equally comfortable executing an urgent partner referral update, troubleshooting a cross-system data discrepancy, analyzing pipeline conversion, presenting program performance to executives, and leading a cross-functional initiative to improve the partner revenue engine.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

#### **Alliance Partner Operations & Lifecycle Management**

* Own day-to-day operational workflows supporting partner onboarding, program enrollment, tiering, enablement tracking, certification or eligibility tracking where applicable, and ongoing program compliance. Specifically with AWS ACE:

* Administer and maintain Megaport's participation in relevant partner ecosystems, including partner profiles, program records, solution listings, sales contacts, and other required operational information.
* Coordinate partner-program renewals, requirements, submissions, and deadlines with Alliance Leadership and relevant internal stakeholders.
* Monitor partner-program health and identify operational gaps that could affect eligibility, referrals, co-selling participation, or commercial outcomes.
* Establish repeatable procedures for routine partner administration while identifying opportunities for automation and reduced manual effort.

#### **Referral Intake, Routing & Co-Sell Execution**

* Execute the intake, validation, registration, acceptance, updating, routing, and follow-through of partner referrals and co-sell opportunities within approved operating rules.
* Align incoming partner opportunities with the appropriate internal sales team, account owner, regional coverage, product portfolio, brand, and go-to-market motion.
* Coordinate with Direct Sales, Channel Sales, SDRs, Customer Success, and other relevant teams to confirm ownership, acceptance, next actions, and timely follow-through.
* Maintain accurate relationships between partner portal opportunity identifiers, sales accounts and opportunities, referral records, and associated activities.
* Monitor unassigned, unaccepted, aging, stalled, incomplete, and at-risk referrals; proactively resolve routine exceptions and escalate decisions outside delegated authority.
* Track partner opportunity progression and coordinate status updates with internal sellers and external partner stakeholders.
* Establish and maintain service-level expectations for referral processing, internal assignment, partner responses, record updates, and exception resolution.
* Ensure partner-system updates comply with the applicable program rules, approved data-sharing practices, and internal governance requirements.

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

The **Payments Implementation Manager** provides day-to-day leadership and direction for a team responsible for delivering successful payment implementations, conversions, and related projects for CSI clients. This role combines people leadership, payments expertise, implementation delivery, client relationship management, and cross-functional coordination to ensure projects are completed accurately, efficiently, and on schedule.

The manager will lead a team supporting a variety of payment solutions and projects, which may include debit cards, ATM services, wire transfers, digital wallets such as Apple Pay and Google Pay, card and ATM deconversions, core conversions, debit card plastics and card art, and instant payment solutions such as FedNow.

This individual will serve as a key point of leadership when projects or client issues require escalation, helping identify risks, connect the appropriate teams, and drive issues toward resolution. The ideal candidate brings experience within banking or financial services, payments, and implementations, along with strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.

**What You’ll Do**

* Provide day-to-day leadership and direction for a team of Payments Implementation professionals.
* Coach and develop employees through regular one-on-one meetings, feedback, training, and ongoing development.
* Hire, train, and support team members while helping ensure the team has the resources and tools necessary to succeed.
* Oversee implementation workload, project assignments, scheduling, and resource planning to support service levels and client commitments.
* Support payment implementation and conversion projects involving areas such as debit cards, ATMs, wire transfers, digital wallets, instant payments, card conversions/deconversions, and related payment solutions.
* Monitor project progress and help ensure implementations remain on schedule while identifying and escalating potential risks.
* Assist with client and financial institution escalations, coordinating with the appropriate teams to resolve issues effectively.
* Partners closely with Product, Project Management, Relationship Management, Customer Care, Development, and other internal teams to support successful delivery.
* Communicate departmental priorities, strategies, policies, and expectations to team members.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, efficiency, consistency, and the overall client implementation experience.
* Monitor team performance against established objectives, service targets, and departmental goals.
* Help ensure the department operates within established staffing and budget guidelines.
* Promote CSI's policies, procedures, culture, and values.
* Use technology and tools such as Microsoft Office, Excel, Smartsheet, and Copilot to support communication, documentation, reporting, and operational efficiency.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 6–8+ years of relevant professional experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience within banking, financial services, or financial technology.
* Demonstrated experience with payments and payment-related solutions, such as debit cards, ATMs, digital wallets, FedNow or other instant payments, or similar payment products.
* Experience supporting or leading client implementations, conversions, or complex projects.
* Demonstrated leadership experience through people management, team leadership, project leadership, mentoring, or similar responsibilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, identify risks, resolve problems, and escalate issues appropriately.
* Strong client-facing communication skills and the ability to navigate challenging or escalated situations.
* Proven ability to work effectively across multiple teams and connect the right stakeholders to drive issues and projects forward.
* Strong organizational, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Excel.
* Experience with Smartsheet is helpful but not required.
* Curiosity and openness to learning how tools such as Microsoft Copilot and AI can improve documentation, communication, research, and operational efficiency.
* Four-year college degree or equivalent professional experience.

**What Will Help You Stand Out**

* Direct experience implementing or supporting debit cards or ATM products.
* Experience implementing, supporting, or managing wire transfer products and services.
* Experience with Apple Pay, Google Pay, digital wallets, FedNow, or other instant payment solutions.
* Experience managing card or ATM conversions and deconversions.
* Experience working directly with banks, credit unions, or other financial institutions.
* Experience managing client escalations and coordinating resolution across Product, Development, Project Management, Customer Care, and Relationship Management teams.
* Previous experience leading an implementation or payment-focused team.

**Why This Role**

This is an opportunity to lead a team working at the intersection of banking, payments, technology, and client delivery. You’ll have the opportunity to develop employees, influence how payment implementations are delivered, solve complex client challenges, and collaborate with teams across CSI to continuously improve the client experience.

**Travel:** Approximately 10% is needed for key client implementations and other business needs

In addition to its award-winning core banking platform, these include the latest in lending, digital banking, payments, financial crime prevention and cybersecurity. jobs.title: ABA Intake Coordinator
jobs.description:
ABA Intake Coordinator

**Headstart Health | Fully Remote | Full-Time**  
**$55,000–$65,000 annually**

Be the warm, welcoming first introduction to Headstart for families seeking autism care. You’ll help families feel heard, understand their next steps, and move through intake with personal, attentive support.

At least one year of professional ABA experience and fluent spoken English are required. We strongly prefer availability for a schedule of approximately **9 a.m.–6 p.m. Pacific or Mountain Time**.

Compensation & Benefits

* $55,000–$65,000 annual salary, based on relevant experience and qualifications.
* Fully remote, full-time position.
* Health-insurance reimbursement to help cover the cost of your coverage.
* Unlimited paid time off, coordinated with your manager to maintain team coverage.
* Close collaboration with the Lead Manager and operations team, with opportunities to develop your skills as Headstart grows.

About Headstart Health

Headstart Health helps Board Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs) build and run independent autism-care practices. We support intake, credentialing, billing, and recruiting so clinicians can focus on providing care to children and families.

About the Role

You’ll guide families from their first conversation with Headstart through gathering records and preparing for the next stage of care. You’ll answer questions, coordinate with referring offices, and keep next steps moving while making each interaction feel personal.

You’ll take ownership of each family’s next steps, manage your daily priorities independently, and follow through on open items. You’ll use sound judgment to resolve routine issues and ask for help when a situation needs additional support. Families should know who to contact, understand what’s needed, and trust you to follow through.

What You’ll Do

* Manage a high-volume pipeline of new inquiries and open leads, welcome families, and conduct scheduled intake calls.
* Proactively follow up by phone, text, and email on missing paperwork and stalled next steps.
* Listen to families’ questions, explain the intake process clearly, and keep them informed.
* Collect and track clinical, insurance, demographic, and intake documents, including service orders and diagnostic evaluations.
* Coordinate with families, referring offices, and schools until required records are received and confirmed complete.
* Review referrals and faxes, document outreach and call outcomes, and maintain accurate Salesforce records.
* Help families complete portal setup and prepare organized handoffs to the next team.
* Flag stalled cases, time-sensitive needs, and complex questions to the Lead Manager, and suggest practical improvements to the family experience.

What You’ll Bring — Required

* At least one year of professional experience in Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA).
* At least one year of experience in patient intake, care coordination, healthcare operations, or a similar frontline support role.
* Fluent spoken English, with the ability to conduct a family intake conversation clearly and confidently.
* A friendly, personable phone presence, strong listening skills, and comfort with frequent calls and outreach.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and dependable follow-through across multiple families at different stages of intake.
* Comfort using digital tools, learning new systems, and handling confidential patient information.
* The ability to take ownership, work independently, ask thoughtful questions, and adapt as processes evolve.

Nice to Have

* Hands-on Salesforce experience, especially managing leads, documenting outreach, and using task queues or reports. Experience with another CRM is also helpful.
* Spanish proficiency or bilingual English/Spanish communication skills. Spanish is a plus, not a requirement.
* Familiarity with insurance eligibility, benefits verification, or payer documentation requirements.
* Experience with Aircall or similar phone systems, virtual fax tools, and Google Workspace.

What Success Looks Like

Families experience you as friendly, welcoming, and dependable. You remember the details, follow up when promised, and keep them informed when something is delayed.

New inquiries and open leads receive timely, consistent outreach. Documentation is complete and accurate, Salesforce records reflect current next steps, and handoffs are organized so families keep moving toward care.

How to Apply

Submit your résumé. You’re welcome to include a brief note about your ABA experience and interest in Headstart, but it isn’t required.

Our interview process will explore your experience supporting families, managing follow-up, and keeping intake organized.

Pay: $55,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* At least one year of professional experience in Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) is required. Please briefly describe your ABA experience, including your role and main responsibilities.

Experience:

* Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA): 1 year (Required)

Language:

* English (Required)
* Spanish (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Eaton’s ES AMER Sector Integration division is currently seeking a Customer Success Manager.

The expected annual salary range for this role is $146000 - $215000 a year. This position is also eligible for a variable incentive program.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

Eaton's Digital Office is seeking a Customer Success Manager to support our expanding portfolio of Brightlayer software solutions. This role will orchestrate the post-sale customer journey, helping customers realize measurable value from Brightlayer solutions while driving adoption, retention, renewal readiness, and expansion opportunities.

Because the Brightlayer customer success capability is still in an early stage of maturity, this is not a purely run-the-playbook CSM role. The successful candidate will be expected to manage customer relationships while also helping build the operating model: scalable lifecycle motions, renewal-readiness practices, account health reporting, Voice of Customer loops, playbooks, and technology-enabled engagement approaches.

The ideal candidate is a senior, data-driven customer success professional who combines trusted-advisor customer skills with operational rigor, commercial awareness, comfort with AI-enabled tools, and the ability to influence across a matrixed organization. This person should be equally comfortable engaging directly with customers, partnering with Sales and Product, and helping define how Brightlayer customer success should scale over time.

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

**Customer Adoption and Value Realization**  

* Facilitate the post-sale customer journey across onboarding, training, adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion support.
* Develop customer success plans that align Brightlayer capabilities to customer objectives, expected outcomes, stakeholders, and adoption milestones.
* Drive adoption through proactive customer engagement, use case reviews, release awareness, business check-ins, and practical guidance on relevant Brightlayer functionality.

**Retention, Renewal Readiness, and Growth**  

* Monitor customer health across adoption, engagement, satisfaction, support trends, renewal timing, stakeholder alignment, and relationship quality.
* Develop renewal-readiness plans with Sales and Commercial Operations to support retention, reduce churn risk, and improve forecast predictability.
* Identify customer success risks and expansion opportunities early, then coordinate cross-functional action plans to protect outcomes and support growth.

**Tech-Touch, Digital Engagement, and AI-Enabled Scale**  

* Help define tech-touch, digital-touch, automated, and AI-assisted engagement models that scale customer success beyond high-touch coverage.
* Contribute to the evaluation, implementation, and optimization of a customer success platform and supporting digital workflows.
* Use AI-enabled capabilities responsibly to improve customer insights, account prioritization, health scoring, renewal risk detection, communications, and repeatable CS workflows.

**Customer Insights and Voice of Customer**  

* Capture customer feedback, business needs, product gaps, and emerging market requirements to serve as an internal advocate for Brightlayer customers.
* Share actionable Voice of Customer insights with Product, Offer Management, Support, Services, Sales, and Commercial Operations to inform roadmap, service, and customer experience improvements.

**Operations, Analytics, and Process Excellence**  

* Track customer success metrics, including adoption, renewal rate, churn risk, customer health, engagement, satisfaction, and value realization.
* Use CRM, customer success tools, dashboards, and analytics to prioritize accounts, identify risks, and inform business recommendations.
* Support the development of customer success processes, playbooks, reporting standards, health-scoring approaches, and operating rhythms.
* Provide regular reporting and insights to leadership on customer health, adoption trends, renewal readiness, and customer success performance.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**  

* Collaborate with Product, Solutions Architects, Professional Services, Customer Support, Offer Management, Commercial Operations, and Sales to coordinate customer outcomes.
* Ensure customer expectations, requirements, and deliverables are clearly understood across internal teams.
* Influence cross-functional stakeholders to remove barriers, accelerate customer outcomes, and improve the overall Brightlayer customer experience.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Basic Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in customer success, account management, commercial operations, customer operations, SaaS, product, or technology-driven customer-facing roles.
* Minimum 5 years of experience working in a B2B software, services, technology, or digital solutions environment.
* Minimum 5 years of experience with customer relationship management systems or customer success tools.
* No relocation is offered for this role.
* Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.

  
  
**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Experience in Enterprise SaaS, industrial software, energy management, power management, electrical infrastructure, digital transformation, or connected solutions.
* Experience developing customer success processes, playbooks, health scoring model

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager - xMatters
jobs.description:
The **Customer Success Manager (CSM)** is a customer-facing technical role within the Global Account Management and Customer Success organization. This role helps strategic xMatters customers adopt the solution, realize value, and achieve their business goals, supporting customer retention and growth.

As part of the Account Management team, the CSM drives xMatters adoption, value realization, customer satisfaction, and retention across an assigned portfolio. The CSM works across the organization as the voice of the customer, sharing feedback and helping remove barriers to adoption and success.

The CSM is a technical subject matter expert in xMatters and its use cases. In partnership with Account Managers, the CSM shares best practices, provides strategic guidance, and helps customers address complex challenges. The CSM also coordinates internal resources for at-risk customers and contributes to a strong, lasting customer experience.

### **What you'll do:**

Build deep technical and business knowledge of xMatters and its use cases. Work directly with customers to configure functionality, demonstrate capabilities, and identify additional ways to use the solution.

Lead adoption and customer success for assigned strategic xMatters accounts in support of retention and growth goals.

Apply knowledge of the industry, customer operations, and emerging needs to recommend relevant xMatters use cases. Develop practical adoption strategies that align with each customer’s goals.

Develop and lead adoption plans that support customer satisfaction goals, including an NPS score above 50. Monitor progress, identify product or business barriers, and coordinate actions to resolve them.

Review customer health and usage metrics, and develop processes and tools that improve xMatters adoption.

Partner with Account Managers on account plans, customer business challenges, risk mitigation, and opportunities to grow relationships.

Coordinate internal teams to resolve complex customer issues.

* Conduct customer health checks by reviewing progress against documented success criteria. Present findings and recommendations that help customers increase the value and use of xMatters.

* Develop practical approaches for customers whose needs are not met by standard configurations, working within product capabilities and established processes.

* Identify potential upsell and cross-sell opportunities through customer success conversations, and refer them to the assigned Account Executive or Account Manager for follow-up.

* Lead customer communications about xMatters product introductions, releases, enhancements, user group meetings, webinars, and other strategic initiatives.

* Share customer feedback with management and contribute to strategic initiatives and program improvements, including coordination with Product on feature requests and roadmap priorities.

* Partner with Implementation and Professional Services teams to understand the status of xMatters engagements and support a smooth transition from deployment to ongoing account management and customer success.

* Work with Product Management to prioritize customer feature requests, identify capability gaps, and communicate product barriers to adoption and effective use.

### **What you'll bring:**

* At least 3 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as pre-sales engineering or consulting, or implementing technical software solutions in DevOps, or major incident management (MIM).

* Experience providing technical account management for large organizations.

* Ability to connect product capabilities to customer needs, explain technical concepts clearly, and recommend ways to improve adoption and deliver measurable value.

* A track record of improving customer retention and growth through a customer-first approach in a complex software environment.

* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate challenging situations professionally with customers and internal teams.

* Strong organization and judgment, with the ability to prioritize work across multiple customers and adjust as needs change.

* Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to engage effectively with executive and C-level stakeholders.

* Ability to work independently with integrity and accountability.

* Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

* Resilience, curiosity, and a customer-first mindset. Builds trust with customers and colleagues and contributes to shared team success.

* Technical experience with agile delivery, CI/CD, SaaS or cloud environments, REST web services, Java or JavaScript (or other programming experience), ITIL, MIM, NOC or incident processes, and operations monitoring.

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology or a related field.

### **Bonus to have:**

* Ability to explain the value of approaches such as Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, ITIL, NOC/SRE, or MIM.

* Experience or training in implementing web-based software applications.

* Experience with Salesforce, Gainsight, Totango, Pendo, or similar tools for tracking adoption and value realization.

At Phillips Pet Food & Supplies, we have been helping independent pet retailers succeed for more than 85 years. As a leading distributor in the pet industry, we are committed to delivering exceptional products, services, and solutions that support the growth of our customers and vendor partners.

We help the world’s most ambitious B2B marketing leaders, executives, and founders communicate what they’re building and why it matters. We don't do template-filling or basic pixel-pushing. **Job Overview**

The National Account Manager for Source Tagging is a high-growth, fast-paced sales role responsible for driving new business and expanding source tagging revenue within an assigned territory. This role is focused on winning new opportunities and developing strategic account relationships with Retail suppliers, consumer goods manufacturers, and packaging companies that support retail products entering major big-box channels.

The ideal candidate will understand how retail suppliers operate within Walmart’s ecosystem, including packaging requirements, retailer expectations, compliance pressures, speed-to-market demands, and the importance of labeling as both a functional and strategic part of the product journey. This individual must be capable of positioning RFID and source-tagging solutions not simply as labels, but as business tools that improve inventory visibility, retail execution, supply chain efficiency, and on-shelf availability.

This position requires someone who understands packaging and labeling construction, material selection, print technologies, application methods, and production environments, while also being able to engage suppliers commercially on how packaging decisions impact retail success. The role will involve targeting suppliers across consumer goods, general merchandise, hard-to-tag products, and emerging categories where RFID adoption is expanding.

Success in this role requires strong prospecting skills, the ability to open new accounts, manage complex sales cycles, and build relationships across procurement, packaging engineering, operations, and executive leadership within customer organizations. The candidate must be comfortable leading business development conversations, identifying unmet needs, and converting those opportunities into long-term revenue growth.

Position Checkpoint as a long-term strategic partner and drive preference for Checkpoint products and solutions.
* Develop and expand relationships with packaging companies and converters: Understand customer packaging requirements, production challenges, and commercial objectives. Position Checkpoint’s portfolio of good, better, and best RFID labeling and source-tagging solutions to meet customer needs while differentiating value against competitive offerings.
* Drive competitive conversion opportunities: Identify competitive accounts, uncover unmet needs, and convert business by demonstrating the technical, commercial, and operational advantages of Checkpoint solutions over alternative suppliers.
* Leverage customer relationships to generate new business growth: Maintain regular communication with existing and prospective customers to identify expansion opportunities, new programs, and emerging applications across retail supplier markets.
* Target Retail suppliers and big-box retail supply chains: Develop business with suppliers supporting retail and other major retailers by understanding retail compliance requirements, packaging expectations, and source-tagging opportunities across consumer goods and general merchandise categories
* Market analysis and competitive intelligence: Monitor RFID market trends, retail mandates, packaging innovations, and competitor activity. Provide market feedback and voice-of-customer insights to internal product development, sales leadership, and strategy teams to support solution advancement.
* Cross-functional internal collaboration: Work closely with product management, operations, technical teams, sourcing, and global commercial teams to ensure customer needs are translated into executable commercial solutions.

* Support strategic growth initiatives: Assist in developing new programs, vertical market strategies, and go-to-market initiatives that accelerate source-tagging adoption across emerging categories.

Legion builds AI-powered workforce management software for enterprises that run hourly workforces in retail, hospitality, facilities management, and manufacturing.

We're hiring a Revenue Enablement Manager to own how our go-to-market team learns, sells, and improves. You'll build onboarding that shortens ramp, run the enablement cadence, launch new products to the field, and reinforce a consistent sales methodology. Sales methodology and process

Content, playbooks, and knowledge

* Drive adoption and ROI of the sales tool stack, partnering with RevOps

At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.

Our posted salary range is done so in good faith based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. We strive to make competitive offers that allow employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant's location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills.
