jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Haven Housing Solutions**

Haven Housing Solutions (HHS) is a turnkey furnished housing company operating in all 50 states. When a family is displaced by a fire, flood, or storm, insurance carriers and their partners call us to get that family into a fully furnished, move in ready home, fast. We also house corporate professionals on assignment and support government agencies. We are lean, we move quickly, we are relationship driven, and we are growing.

**Why This Role**

* **Uncapped commission.** Every placement you close pays you. No cap, no ceiling.
* **Six figure earning potential.** Base salary plus commission, with top performers clearing six figures.
* **Fully remote, flexible hours.** Work from home on a flexible schedule.
* **A real path up.** We promote from within. Prove it here and grow into a Team Lead, and leadership roles as HHS scales.
* **A modern sales stack.** Salesforce, M365, AI tools, and automation built to keep you selling instead of doing busy work.
* **Work that matters.** Every deal you close puts a displaced family into a home during one of the hardest weeks of their lives.

**What You Will Do**

* Prospect and cold call insurance adjusters, claims teams, third party administrators, and public adjusters to open new accounts and grow existing ones.
* Run outbound sequences in Salesforce and build relationships that turn into repeat business.
* Work incoming housing requests fast: review options, negotiate with landlords and property managers, and build tiered quotes that win.
* Present options quickly, handle objections, and close the placement.
* Coordinate tours, collect lease details, and hand off cleanly to our Customer Care team for move in.
* Keep every account, contact, and deal accurate and current in Salesforce.
* Use AI every day to research accounts, prep for calls, draft outreach, and move faster.
* Hit and beat your monthly placement and revenue targets.

**What You Must Bring**

* 2+ years of cold calling and outbound sales experience with a track record of hitting or beating quota.
* Hands on Salesforce experience: managing a pipeline, logging activity, and working from reports.
* Daily, practical use of AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, or Grok, and the drive to keep getting better with them.
* Commission motivation: you want your income tied to your results.
* Clear, confident, professional written and verbal English; you will speak daily with insurance professionals daily.
* Self-starter who manages a full pipeline without being chased.
* Authorized to work in the US, with a quiet home office and reliable high-speed internet.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in insurance housing, ALE, corporate housing, relocation, property management, real estate, or insurance claims.
* Experience with Dialpad or a similar VoIP dialer, and Microsoft 365.
* Experience with Salesforce Cadences or another sales engagement tool.

**No housing experience? No problem.** We will teach you the industry. You bring the sales drive.

**Is This You?**

**You will thrive here if**:

* Money motivates you and you want to be paid for performance.
* You would rather make one more call than leave a deal on the table.
* You track your own numbers and push to beat them.
* You want a seat that grows as the company grows.

**This is not the role for you if** you want the same paycheck regardless of results, you avoid the phone, or you need someone telling you what to do next.

**Compensation and Benefits**

**Pay range**: $80,000 to $130,000+ per year (base salary plus uncapped commission)

* Base salary plus uncapped commission on every placement you close.
* Performance bonuses on top of commission for high volume months.
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401(k) retirement plan.
* Paid time off and company holidays.
* Fully remote with flexible working hours.
* Ongoing training in Salesforce, AI tools, and the insurance housing market.
* A clear advancement path for top performers.

Full compensation details are shared during the interview process.

Submit your resume with a short note answering these two questions:

* What was your best month in outbound sales, and what drove it?
* How do you use AI in your sales workflow today?

**Applications without answers to both questions will not be considered.**

----------------

At**Cardiovascular Associates of America (CVAUSA)****,** we believe the total cost of cardiovascular care is too high. The best way to find and remove avoidable cost is to equip cardiovascular physicians with new care models and new financial incentives through risk-based contracts.  
  
CVAUSA's value-based care division supports partner practices in transforming care models to improve quality, achieve the triple aim, and implement risk-based contracting. We are passionate about expanding access to evidence-based chronic disease care and building durable payment models that reward clinicians for delivering the right care, in the right place, at the right time.

------------------------

* Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key partner stakeholders.

* Track quality, utilization, and total-cost-of-care results against each contract's targets, including shared savings and downside-risk terms.

**Strategic alignment**

* Understand the financial, clinical, and operational drivers of risk-bearing cardiology agreements.

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

Are you technically minded, detail-oriented, and interested in helping customers successfully implement and connect new technology? CSI is seeking a **Technical Implementation Specialist** to support the hands-on installation, configuration, integration, deployment, and validation of CSI software for new and existing customers. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys a blend of **technical implementation, SQL, data integration, troubleshooting, and customer interaction**. You’ll work with technical environments, databases, data exchanges, connectivity, APIs, and system interfaces while partnering with customers and internal teams to ensure successful implementations.

**In This Role**

You’ll be responsible for accurately and efficiently completing assigned technical implementation activities using established processes and procedures. You’ll troubleshoot technical issues, validate data and integrations, support deployments and go-lives, and escalate more complex issues when needed.

**What You’ll Do**

* Perform technical environment setup and standard software installation and configuration.
* Build, run, and validate flat-file extracts based on defined specifications.
* Verify record counts, file layouts, and data quality before delivery.
* Run SQL queries and scripts to validate, troubleshoot, and correct converted data.
* Assist with configuring, testing, and validating file-based and API integrations between CSI solutions and customer or third-party systems.
* Troubleshoot installation, connectivity, file-transfer, data, and configuration issues and escalate more complex problems when needed.
* Support deployment and go-live activities, including cutover tasks and post-deployment validation.
* Deploy code, configuration packages, or releases to test environments when required by the solution or implementation process.
* Document technical configurations, file specifications, testing results, and issue-resolution steps.
* Communicate directly with customer technical contacts while working with senior team members and internal partners.
* Stay current on relevant CSI products, technical standards, and product enhancements.
* Travel as needed to support customer implementations and business needs.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**What We’re Looking For**

* At least 2 years of relevant experience in technical implementation, systems administration, data integration, technical support, or a comparable technical role.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
* Experience or familiarity with secure file transfer and file-based data formats.
* Understanding of server operating environments and network connectivity.
* Familiarity with APIs and system integrations is beneficial.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to follow technical specifications and established implementation procedures while recognizing when an issue should be escalated.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with data conversions, integrations, and validation.
* Ability to communicate technical information effectively with customers and internal teams.
* Education or job knowledge equivalent to an undergraduate education in a technical discipline, or equivalent technical experience or certifications.

**What Makes Someone Successful in This Role**

* You enjoy getting into the technical details and figuring out why something isn't working.
* You're comfortable working with data, SQL, files, integrations, connectivity, and system configurations.
* You can follow a defined process while still using critical thinking to identify potential issues.
* You're organized and comfortable balancing multiple implementation tasks and deadlines.
* You communicate well with both technical teams and customers.
* You're eager to continue developing your technical knowledge and grow into increasingly complex implementation work.

jobs.title: Customer Success Executive
jobs.description:
Overview:

HealthEdge® offers AI-powered operational infrastructure for health insurance companies, guaranteeing an enduring financial edge in an increasingly competitive market. We're experiencing strong market momentum, with a growing number of health plans choosing HealthEdge to modernize their operations and compete more effectively. As we expand, we're investing in the people who power that growth, making this a pivotal moment to join us and shape the future of healthcare technology. Learn more at HealthEdge.com.

**ROLE SUMMARY**

HealthEdge's customer success strategy depends on four organizational capabilities: achieving customer outcomes, retaining and converting referenceable customers, expanding revenue within the existing customer base, and maintaining data and reporting integrity. The CSE is an essential delivery partner in all four — owning defined workstreams, managing critical relationship layers, and keeping the operational machinery of customer success running with precision.

This is not a support role. It is an outcome ownership role at a defined scope. A CSE at HealthEdge is accountable for the workstreams they own within the customer's success plan — and for keeping those workstreams current, honest, and moving without being asked.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

Responsibilities are organized by the four strategic outcomes the CSE organization exists to deliver. These are not task lists — they are outcome areas with clear accountability.

**Customer Outcomes**

* Own defined workstreams within the Customer Success Plan for every assigned account — keeping your sections current, evidence-based, and tied to the customer's business objectives, not HealthEdge's delivery milestones.
* Support the Senior CSE in quarterbacking execution across Delivery, Operations, Technology, and Product. Own every task you've been assigned until it is closed — not until you've sent it to someone else.
* Understand the HealthEdge platform capabilities relevant to your assigned accounts well enough to support executive preparation and translate delivery activity into customer language.

**Customer Retention &** **Referenceability**

* Surface account risk before the customer does — identify the signal, act on it, and flag it appropriately with context already framed: what you're seeing, why it matters, and what you recommend.
* Own assigned pieces of the Path to Green plan for every at-risk account — keep the issue list current and honest, track every action to closure, and never let a recovery item die in a seam.
* Support reference-development plans by maintaining strong VP/Director relationships that make customers willing, credible advocates.

**Customer Revenue Expansion**

* Maintain a current view of each assigned customer's strategic direction and flag multi-product or cross-sell signals to the Senior CSE with context — what you heard, from whom, and what it might mean commercially.
* Know the basics of each assigned account's contract — what was bought, key SLAs, renewal timing — well enough to recognize when an operational issue has client implications and flag it immediately.
* Support clean handoffs to Sales when expansion opportunities are identified — nothing falls in the seam.

**Data & Reporting Discipline**

* Keep health scoring, CRM records, and success plans accurate, complete, and current — audit-ready at all times.
* Contribute to consolidated reporting that gives leadership a trusted single source of truth.
* Flag data gaps or health score discrepancies proactively — don't let a reporting issue become a surprise.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5+ years in health plan operations or an adjacent healthcare role. Direct customer-facing experience — account management, implementation support, or customer service — with at least one example of owning an issue end to end.
* Foundational literacy across payer operations — follows an operational conversation in any domain and knows where to go for depth. Basic regulatory and plan-finance awareness, with working knowledge expected within 12–18 months.
* Knows the basics of assigned accounts' contracts — what was bought, key SLAs, renewal timing — well enough to recognize when an operational issue has commercial implications and flags it. Building toward commercial fluency; never negotiates, always escalates commercial questions framed.
* Operates inside a recovery with full ownership of assigned pieces: keeps the issue list current and honest, tracks every action to closure, preps status materials, and never lets recovery items die in a seam. Learns escalation mechanics by running the machinery of one.
* Demonstrated workstream management — has personally run a plan with named owners, dates, and dependencies through to completion, including tracking actions to closure and keeping stakeholders current without being asked. Formal methodology or certification (PMP, agile/scrum) a plus, not required.
* Exposure to payer claims, pricing, or medical-management platforms (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthRules Payer, or comparable systems). Comfortable with communication and project-management tools; willing adopter of AI tools (e.g., Claude). Knows which technical roles exist and when to pull them in.

**Preferred (Not Required)**

* Hands-on exposure to a system implementation, platform migration, or major upgrade from any seat — testing, data conversion, cutover support, training, or PMO. Has lived the rhythm of a go-live. Experience on the health-plan side of a vendor relationship — having been the customer is a differentiator. HealthEdge product suite familiarity.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

**In the First 90 Days**

* Has reviewed and understands the success plan for every assigned account — knows the outcome, the current health score, and the open workstreams.
* Owns at least one defined workstream per assigned account and is keeping it current, honest, and moving without being asked.
* Has built working relationships with key internal counterpart

new_jobs.description:
**Senior People Operations Manager (Senior HR Generalist)**

**About Inferra**

Inferra builds hyperscaler-quality AI infrastructure as standardized, modular blocks that are assembled onsite, not constructed, and combine to build any data center at any scale, anywhere. Built to Tier III standards, our platforms support NVIDIA Blackwell and Vera Rubin and a growing range of accelerators, from 1–2 MW at the edge to 100 MW–1 GW campuses, live about six months from order.

Power is the constraint on AI, and powered land is the heart of our offer. We have secured more than 3 GW of powered land across thousands of 2–5 MW sites, hundreds of 5–20 MW sites and dozens of 20–100 MW sites, and the portfolio grows every month. Because our modules are small, quiet, need no water connection and go where infrastructure already exists, we can use power that traditional data centers cannot.

We serve frontier labs, hyperscalers, inference clouds and enterprises. Inferra is backed by General Catalyst and led by a founding team that has built and scaled infrastructure companies before.

**The Role**

Inferra is about to grow from about 20 people to a company that deploys 420 MW in 2027, at 35 sites a month from July. You'll be our second People hire and you'll run the HR operating engine that makes that ramp possible: fast, well-run hiring, a great first week for every new employee, and compliance in every state where we employ people.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You'll build processes from scratch, run them yourself, and get them ready for a company several times our size. You'll work closely with the VP of People, the founders and every team lead.

**What You'll Do**

* **Speed to hire.** Run recruiting coordination in Ashby: scheduling, candidate communication, references, background checks and offer paperwork, so offers go out in hours, not weeks.
* **Onboarding.** Own onboarding from signed offer to day 1 and through 30, 60 and 90-day check-ins, so every new hire is productive in their first week.
* **Multi-state compliance.** Own daily compliance across California, Washington, Colorado, Kansas and new states as we grow: I-9s, state notices, required training, leave, final pay and personnel records.
* **Payroll, benefits and HR systems.** Administer payroll and benefits through Insperity, run open enrollment, and lead the project to move to an in-house HR system such as Rippling.
* **SOC 2.** Run the HR controls behind SOC 2: background checks, signed agreements, security training, and onboarding and offboarding records tied to system access. Keep the evidence audit-ready.
* **Policies.** Publish and maintain the employee handbook and multi-state policies with counsel, and roll out working norms across the company.
* **Employee relations.** Be the first point of contact for employee questions and concerns; document, advise and escalate to the VP of People.
* **Data and reporting.** Keep people data accurate across Ashby, payroll and the HR system, and produce the monthly people dashboard.

**Who You Are**

* 8+ years in HR or People Operations, including 3+ years at a venture-backed startup through rapid growth
* Hands-on with multi-state employment compliance, especially California
* Experience with PEOs and HR systems such as Insperity, TriNet, Rippling, Gusto or BambooHR
* Has run benefits, payroll, onboarding and offboarding end to end
* Has supported recruiting at volume, ideally in Ashby or a similar applicant tracking system
* Has supported a SOC 2 or similar audit with HR controls and evidence
* Organized, fast and discreet; comfortable building from nothing and doing the work yourself

**Nice to Have**

* Has moved a company from a PEO to an in-house HR system
* Experience with field, construction or data center workforces, contractors and staffing agencies
* Experience with work visas (H-1B, PERM) alongside immigration counsel
* SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR or SPHR certification

**What Success Looks Like**

* **Day 30:** Onboarding playbook live for the January starts; day-1 kit and offboarding checklist in use; multi-state compliance audit done, with gaps fixed or scheduled.
* **Day 60:** Benefits guide and open-enrollment plan; handbook and multi-state policies drafted for counsel; 30/60/90 check-ins running for every hire.
* **Day 90:** Recommendation on staying with Insperity or moving in-house; HR controls mapped for SOC 2; recruiting coordination running for every open role.

**Why Inferra**

* **Founding People team.** You'll build People Operations at a company scaling fast, with direct access to the founders.
* **Real impact.** Your work decides how fast we can hire and how well we keep the people we hire.
* **Meaningful ownership.** Founding-level equity in a company building critical infrastructure for the AI era.

**Equal Opportunity**

Inferra is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you need an accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, email [careers@inferra.ai]. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act and applicable local law.

**Recruiters and Agencies**

Inferra does not accept unsolicited résumés from recruiters or agencies. Please don't contact our employees or send candidate profiles. We won't pay a fee for any candidate submitted without a signed agreement with Inferra.

**About LCC3 Solution Inc**

LCC3 Solution Inc. provides industrial design-build services, including design coordination, procurement, construction management, installation, and commissioning for advanced manufacturing and high-tech facilities. **Position Summary**

Support the PM with daily coordination, written communication, schedules, procurement, cost records, and project documentation. This hands-on role supports industrial facilities, cleanrooms, and laboratory projects. Success means keeping accurate records, following up on commitments, and escalating issues early with a clear status and next action.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

***Project Coordination***

* Maintain action and issue logs with responsible parties, due dates, and status; follow up with owners, designers, subcontractors, and suppliers until items are resolved.
* Update schedules, milestones, and short-term lookaheads using field input; flag late approvals, missing owner information, design dependencies, and delivery risks to the PM.

***Subcontractor and Vendor Management***

* Prepare RFQs, organize quotations, and compile comparisons of scope, exclusions, price, lead time, and delivery terms for PM review.

***Documentation and Project Administration***

* Maintain organized contracts, drawings, revisions, RFIs, submittals, meeting minutes, and correspondence; distribute current documents and track responses and approvals.
* Follow up with U.S. Architects/Engineers and overseas design teams on drawing updates, owner inputs, and outstanding technical questions.
* Maintain a potential change order log; compile owner instructions, emails, drawing revisions, field records, quotations, and schedule impacts for PM review.
* Help prepare change order proposals, progress payment applications, schedule of values updates, and invoice tracking; check supporting documents and flag discrepancies.

***Site Support and Quality Assurance***

* Collect daily reports, progress photos, manpower information, and field constraints; compare reported progress with planned activities and notify the PM of deviations.
* Track permit and inspection status, required documents, and corrective actions with the field team and Architect/Engineer; support TCO/CO preparation and closeout.
* Maintain punch lists and coordinate testing and turnover records, including cleanroom test reports, equipment startup records, as-builts, warranties, and O&M manuals.
* Follow site safety requirements, use required PPE, and promptly report observed safety or quality concerns to the responsible field leader and PM.

***Communication and Reporting***

* Draft clear English and Mandarin emails, meeting summaries, and project updates; accurately communicate technical and commercial information between project teams.
* Prepare a concise weekly status report covering progress, procurement, pending decisions, changes, and risks; highlight items requiring PM action.
* Work under PM direction. Obtain approval before issuing commitments involving price, scope, schedule, or contract terms; route technical approvals to the responsible professionals.

**Required Qualifications**

* Fluent written and spoken English and Mandarin; able to draft professional emails and take accurate meeting minutes in both languages.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and persistent follow-up; able to manage competing deadlines and ask clear questions when information is incomplete.
* Proficiency in Excel, Word, Outlook, and Teams; able to maintain tracking spreadsheets, compare quotations, and organize project files.

* Ability to read design drawings and coordinate with design institutes
* Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and ability to work on-site and travel between project locations as needed.

* Exposure to industrial, cleanroom, semiconductor, or laboratory projects, including mechanical, electrical, plumbing, or process utility coordination.

Competitive salary based on experience; company-sponsored benefits subject to eligibility; hands-on mentorship; and opportunities to grow into project engineering or project management responsibilities.

The Contractor will assist Biomedical Engineering leadership with the planning, coordination, implementation, tracking, and completion of medical equipment and healthcare technology projects across County hospitals, clinics, and other healthcare facilities. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

We're hiring a GTM Onboarding Lead to own Global Onboarding within GTM Enablement. Harvey is hiring go-to-market talent faster than at any point in its history, and in 2027 the GTM organization will more than double across AMER, EMEA and APAC. You will own role-specific ramp tracks, bootcamp cohorts, milestone certifications, 30/60/90 frameworks, ramp measurement, the LMS and content system, and the everboarding curriculum that keeps tenured reps current. Are you interested in helping to shape the era of Artificial Intelligence (AI)? AI is transforming entire industries and fundamentally changing the way we live and work. AWS is the place where organizations build AI technology securely, responsibly, and with confidence. AWS is positioned at the forefront of GenAI with the deepest set of services and features as the leader in cloud.  
  
  
  
  
As a Senior Account Manager for Startups at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will be the strategic lead responsible for driving cloud adoption within a group of stellar startups at the forefront of machine learning development.
  
  
AWS offers a complete set of cloud services that enable all companies, from startups to enterprises, to run virtually everything in the cloud, including application development, model training, big data analytics, and AI/ML platforms.  
  
  
  
  
Frontier Startups, represent a critically important subset of customers to AWS. These companies have unique needs, technical considerations, sales cycles, and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional companies. As AWS continues to rapidly grow, we seek a Frontier Startup Account Manager to earn trust and help drive growth amongst a set of well-funded, high-potential startups.  
  
  
  
  
The ideal candidate possesses a strong sales acumen, knowledge of the startup ecosystem, a passion for (and familiarity with) machine learning and frontier technology trends. You will be working with startups building cutting edge AI and ML solutions, so extensive collaboration with external contacts and internal teams will be key to build and execute on plans to meet and exceed sales quota. Your responsibilities will include driving revenue, gaining executive buy in and alignment, accelerating innovation through service adoption, and ensuring these startups select AWS as their primary cloud provider.  
  
  
  
  
You will align closely with counterparts in business development, marketing, solution architecture, and partner teams to lead execution of coordinated go-to-market strategies and sales plays. You will also work closely with business development teams who are driving strategic support, global co-programming, and portfolio engagement to help drive top-of-funnel customer acquisition and accelerate seller cycles in the field.  
  
  
  
  
Candidates will be working with startups building cutting edge AI and ML solutions and should have a good understanding of machine learning technologies and how startups are using them to enhance services and processes for end customers. The ideal candidate will have a strong entrepreneurial spirit who is prepared to work in a fast-paced, often ambiguous environment, execute against ambitious goals, and consistently embrace the Amazon Culture.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Prospect, Scope, Develop, and Close complex, multi-dimensional deals involving technology, go-to-market packages, and programs
  
  
Align with customer success criteria to deliver value early (mid to late stage startups)
  
  
Drive revenue and market share in a defined territory or industry vertical
  
  
Accelerate customer adoption of AWS services through well-developed sales engagements and successful GTM Strategy
  
  
Meet or exceed quarterly revenue and goal targets
  
  
Develop and execute against a comprehensive account/territory plan.
  
  
Accelerate customer adoption by engaging Founders, CxO, Board of Directors and VC influencers
  
  
Work with partners to extend reach & drive adoption
  
  
Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts
  
  
Successfully work in a large-scale environment, leading collaboration with AWS resources (Solution Architects, Business Development, Marketing, Partners, Support, and Service teams) to drive customer solution adoption at scale.  
  
  
  
  
About the team  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
  
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
  
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
  
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

new_jobs.title: Field Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
FireMon delivers Network Security Policy Control for the Modern Enterprise.

Most enterprises run firewalls from multiple vendors alongside cloud security groups and microsegmentation platforms, and no single console can say whether it all works together. We believe policy is the control plane for network security: it defines what the environment should do, and the infrastructure carries it out. FireMon gives security teams one place to see, govern, and prove that their policy is doing what they intend, across on-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments.

The Field Operations & Enablement Manager makes FireMon's field team faster, more consistent, and better prepared in every customer and partner conversation. You'll own two connected areas: the operating rhythm of the field (process, data, forecasting, and tools) and the enablement program that gets sellers, sales engineers, and partners ready to win.

Why this role exists: Our best sellers win through sharper strategy, not more activity. This role spreads that edge across the whole field by turning deal insight, market knowledge, and commercial judgment into repeatable plays, coaching, and programs.

### **Responsibilities**

**Field** **O****perations**

* Drive adoption of the core field tech stack (Salesforce, sales engagement, Gong, deal registration, and content tools), working with the Salesforce Admin on the workflow and process changes that go-to-market (GTM) strategy, product launches, and pricing updates require.

* Design and maintain territory, account, and partner assignments with Sales and Channel leadership.

* Support the field operating cadence: forecast and pipeline reviews, territory and account planning, QBRs, sales kickoff, and regional meetings, including logistics.

* Build KPI dashboards and reports for the sales team on bookings, pipeline coverage, win rates, deal velocity, and partner-sourced revenue.

* Standardize deal desk inputs, including quoting (CPQ), approvals, and handoffs to Finance and CX.

* Analyze win/loss patterns, pricing outcomes, and field feedback, and bring data-backed findings to Product Marketing and Product Management.

* Sharpen ideal customer profiles (ICPs), account tiering, and target account plays, and find whitespace in the existing customer base.

**Sales** **E****nablement**

* Build and run a structured onboarding program that gets new sellers to first qualified pipeline within 90 days, backed by level-up learning and 1:1 or small-group sessions.

* Create a role-based training curriculum covering FireMon products, the security policy management market, buyer personas, discovery, and competitive positioning, with certification and ongoing reinforcement on core messaging, demos, and qualification methodology (for example, MEDDPICC).

* Partner with Product Marketing to turn GTM strategy, product launches, pricing and messaging updates, and win/loss findings into field-ready playbooks, value narratives, battlecards, and talk tracks.

* Extend enablement to channel partners through partner onboarding, certification paths, and co-selling resources.

* Own the sales content platform (such as Highspot or GTM Buddy): organize content by sales stage, persona, and use case, retire outdated assets, and track usage and deal influence so reps find current, approved material in under a minute.

* Partner with Sales leadership on deal and call reviews using Gong) and other GTM techs, track skill gaps, and measure enablement impact against ramp time, win rate, and quota attainment, adjusting programs based on what the data shows.

### **Required Skills and Experience**

* 5+ years in sales operations, revenue operations, or sales enablement at a B2B software company, with at least 2 years owning programs end to end.

* Hands-on Salesforce experience building reports, dashboards, and pipeline and forecast processes, plus the analytical judgment to turn messy data into a decision and a plan.

* A track record of building onboarding or training programs that measurably shortened ramp time or lifted win rates.

* Experience supporting enterprise sales motions with long cycles and multiple stakeholders.

* Strong facilitation and presentation skills, comfortable in front of sellers, sales engineers, and product teams and executives.

* Hands-on CPQ, Salesforce and enablement platform experience.

* Experience defining ideal customer profiles, account segmentation, or target account programs.

### **Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Background in cybersecurity, network security, or infrastructure software.

* Experience in a channel-led or partner-transacted sales model.

* Familiarity with MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or a similar methodology, and tools such as 6sense, Highspot, GTM Buddy, and ZoomInfo.

* Experience building playbooks and programs that change field behavior in a high-growth environment.

Cat5 Resources is a diversified supplier of technical and operational services across the Southern US, Puerto Rico, and the US Virgin Islands.

She responded without hesitation, mobilizing a fleet of generators and emergency fuel to ensure the client’s critical infrastructure remained operational throughout the event.

new_jobs.description:
ECS is seeking a **Deputy Project Manager**to work ***in a part time, hybrid capacity,*** for the US Postal Service's Office of the Inspector General (OIG) in **Arlington, VA**.

This position supports the USPIS Contract Manager in the overall leadership, administration, and performance of the USPS/USPIS security services contract. This position serves as the designated alternate and assumes the Contract Manager's responsibilities and authority when the Contract Manager is unavailable, ensuring uninterrupted management oversight, customer communication, staffing, training, quality assurance, and contract performance.

***Note:*** *C**andidates must be able to pass a* ***USPIS Moderate Background Investigation (MBI)*** *and obtain a USPS Public Trust (elevated) clearance. This* **requires** ***US Citizenship and the ability to pass an in-depth background check.*** *Also, this role is contingent upon contract award.*

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support the Contract Manager in directing day-to-day contract operations and ensuring compliance with the Statement of Work, Task Orders, USPS policies, Post Orders, and applicable federal, state, and local requirements.
* Serve as the authorized alternate point of contact for USPS/USPIS when the Contract Manager is unavailable; provide timely acknowledgement, action updates, and resolution of contract-level issues.
* Maintain 24/7 availability, as required by the SOW, to respond to urgent operational matters, emergencies, customer requests, staffing disruptions, and other contract-level issues.
* Assume full Contract Manager responsibilities during periods of absence, including operational decision-making, coordination with USPS/USPIS representatives, performance oversight, and escalation management.
* Coordinate with Regional Managers, Site Managers, Site Supervisors, and other program personnel to maintain staffing, supervision, post coverage, service continuity, and consistent delivery of security services.
* Monitor staffing levels, vacancies, call-offs, overtime, relief and reserve resources, and transition requirements to support the program's zero-open-post objective.
* Support continuity-of-operations and rapid-deployment activities during staffing shortages, emergencies, severe weather, civil unrest, transportation disruptions, communications outages, and other contingencies.
* Ensure the program maintains qualified personnel who meet applicable training, licensing, credentialing, firearms qualification, background, and post-specific requirements.
* Review operational reports, incidents, quality-assurance findings, corrective actions, customer concerns, and performance trends; coordinate corrective measures and track resolution to completion.
* Support implementation and maintenance of the program's quality-control plan, including site inspections, supervisory observations, performance reviews, audits, and continuous-improvement initiatives.
* Assist in the development, review, and implementation of Task Order Security Operations Plans, Post Orders, emergency procedures, staffing plans, transition plans, and other required program deliverables.
* Coordinate with the Training Manager and operational leadership to ensure required training, refresher training, remedial training, and tabletop exercises are completed and documented.
* Support use of the program's scheduling, reporting, and dashboard platforms to monitor attendance, staffing, training compliance, qualifications, incidents, inspections, and performance metrics.
* Prepare and submit program reports, briefing materials, staffing updates, corrective-action responses, and other deliverables required by USPS/USPIS or the Contract Manager.
* Maintain effective communication with USPS/USPIS representatives, subcontractors, and internal support teams to promptly address operational needs and emerging risks.
* Participate in customer meetings, performance reviews, exercises, and site visits as directed.

*Salary Range: $65-85 / hr. (part time)*

*General Description of Benefits*

Requirements:

* Five or more years of progressively responsible management or supervisory experience supporting security, law-enforcement, military, protective-services, or comparable operational programs.
* Experience managing armed and unarmed security personnel across multiple sites, shifts, or jurisdictions.
* Demonstrated knowledge of contract operations, staffing, scheduling, training, licensing, credentialing, incident response, quality assurance, and continuity planning.
* Experience communicating with customers, senior leadership, field management, and operational personnel.
* Ability to make sound operational decisions independently and assume Contract Manager responsibilities when designated.
* Availability to support the program on a 24/7 basis, including emergency response and urgent operational requirements.
* Strong written, verbal, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, including Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
* Ability to travel as needed to support program operations, customer meetings, transition activities, and site oversight.

9. Escalate issues and work proactively with cross functional teams to find suitable resolution.

10. Communicate regularly with internal and external stakeholders to maintain support and alignment for the program.

11. Identify and coordinate process improvement opportunities.

12. Manage new hire/internal transfers into the Program. This includes, but is not limited to welcome call; coordinating NEO/Epic/Specialty Training; organizing first assignment details; requesting all needed system-wide access and badge; create electronic employee file; obtaining all required program paperwork; onboarding checklists.

13. DHHR – ensure recruitment team obtains & submits all required paperwork and schedules initial fingerprint appointments. Manage renewals as needed.

14. Identify system-wide onboarding requirements for CRNAs in the Staffing Solutions Program. Ensure CBLs are completed in a timely manner by hospital deadlines.

15. Send & review assignment evaluations to unit managers. Perform 90 day and year end reviews.

16. Work with HR & Employee Relations on performance improvement plans.

17. Send monthly reports to each system hospital HR & Education Departments of SSP staff on assignment at their location.

18. Create Program Materials including monthly newsletters, resource guides, informational flyers, forms.

19. Manage day to day needs of employees in the program which requires being available 24/7. This includes, but is not limited to call-offs, shift swaps, resolving conflicts, access issues, payroll issues, scheduling, PTO requests, patient safety concerns, etc.

20. Manage and update program guidelines.

21. Serve as a mentor to clinical staff, identifying growth opportunities and educational needs. Consider factors related to safety, effectiveness, and cost in planning and managing clinical professional development activities.

new_jobs.title: ABA Intake Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
ABA Intake Coordinator

**Headstart Health | Fully Remote | Full-Time**  
**$55,000–$65,000 annually**

Be the warm, welcoming first introduction to Headstart for families seeking autism care. You’ll help families feel heard, understand their next steps, and move through intake with personal, attentive support.

At least one year of professional ABA experience and fluent spoken English are required. We strongly prefer availability for a schedule of approximately **9 a.m.–6 p.m. Pacific or Mountain Time**.

Compensation & Benefits

* $55,000–$65,000 annual salary, based on relevant experience and qualifications.
* Fully remote, full-time position.
* Health-insurance reimbursement to help cover the cost of your coverage.
* Unlimited paid time off, coordinated with your manager to maintain team coverage.
* Close collaboration with the Lead Manager and operations team, with opportunities to develop your skills as Headstart grows.

About Headstart Health

Headstart Health helps Board Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs) build and run independent autism-care practices. We support intake, credentialing, billing, and recruiting so clinicians can focus on providing care to children and families.

About the Role

You’ll guide families from their first conversation with Headstart through gathering records and preparing for the next stage of care. You’ll answer questions, coordinate with referring offices, and keep next steps moving while making each interaction feel personal.

You’ll take ownership of each family’s next steps, manage your daily priorities independently, and follow through on open items. You’ll use sound judgment to resolve routine issues and ask for help when a situation needs additional support. Families should know who to contact, understand what’s needed, and trust you to follow through.

What You’ll Do

* Manage a high-volume pipeline of new inquiries and open leads, welcome families, and conduct scheduled intake calls.
* Proactively follow up by phone, text, and email on missing paperwork and stalled next steps.
* Listen to families’ questions, explain the intake process clearly, and keep them informed.
* Collect and track clinical, insurance, demographic, and intake documents, including service orders and diagnostic evaluations.
* Coordinate with families, referring offices, and schools until required records are received and confirmed complete.
* Review referrals and faxes, document outreach and call outcomes, and maintain accurate Salesforce records.
* Help families complete portal setup and prepare organized handoffs to the next team.
* Flag stalled cases, time-sensitive needs, and complex questions to the Lead Manager, and suggest practical improvements to the family experience.

What You’ll Bring — Required

* At least one year of professional experience in Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA).
* At least one year of experience in patient intake, care coordination, healthcare operations, or a similar frontline support role.
* Fluent spoken English, with the ability to conduct a family intake conversation clearly and confidently.
* A friendly, personable phone presence, strong listening skills, and comfort with frequent calls and outreach.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and dependable follow-through across multiple families at different stages of intake.
* Comfort using digital tools, learning new systems, and handling confidential patient information.
* The ability to take ownership, work independently, ask thoughtful questions, and adapt as processes evolve.

Nice to Have

* Hands-on Salesforce experience, especially managing leads, documenting outreach, and using task queues or reports. Experience with another CRM is also helpful.
* Spanish proficiency or bilingual English/Spanish communication skills. Spanish is a plus, not a requirement.
* Familiarity with insurance eligibility, benefits verification, or payer documentation requirements.
* Experience with Aircall or similar phone systems, virtual fax tools, and Google Workspace.

What Success Looks Like

Families experience you as friendly, welcoming, and dependable. You remember the details, follow up when promised, and keep them informed when something is delayed.

New inquiries and open leads receive timely, consistent outreach. Documentation is complete and accurate, Salesforce records reflect current next steps, and handoffs are organized so families keep moving toward care.

How to Apply

Submit your résumé. You’re welcome to include a brief note about your ABA experience and interest in Headstart, but it isn’t required.

Our interview process will explore your experience supporting families, managing follow-up, and keeping intake organized.

Pay: $55,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* At least one year of professional experience in Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) is required. Please briefly describe your ABA experience, including your role and main responsibilities.

Experience:

* Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA): 1 year (Required)

Language:

* English (Required)
* Spanish (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

Sharecare is a digital healthcare company that delivers software and tech-enabled services to stakeholders across the healthcare ecosystem to help improve care quality, drive better outcomes, and lower costs. new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
Eaton’s ES AMER Sector Integration division is currently seeking a Customer Success Manager.

The expected annual salary range for this role is $146000 - $215000 a year. This position is also eligible for a variable incentive program.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

Eaton's Digital Office is seeking a Customer Success Manager to support our expanding portfolio of Brightlayer software solutions. This role will orchestrate the post-sale customer journey, helping customers realize measurable value from Brightlayer solutions while driving adoption, retention, renewal readiness, and expansion opportunities.

Because the Brightlayer customer success capability is still in an early stage of maturity, this is not a purely run-the-playbook CSM role. The successful candidate will be expected to manage customer relationships while also helping build the operating model: scalable lifecycle motions, renewal-readiness practices, account health reporting, Voice of Customer loops, playbooks, and technology-enabled engagement approaches.

The ideal candidate is a senior, data-driven customer success professional who combines trusted-advisor customer skills with operational rigor, commercial awareness, comfort with AI-enabled tools, and the ability to influence across a matrixed organization. This person should be equally comfortable engaging directly with customers, partnering with Sales and Product, and helping define how Brightlayer customer success should scale over time.

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

**Customer Adoption and Value Realization**  

* Facilitate the post-sale customer journey across onboarding, training, adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion support.
* Develop customer success plans that align Brightlayer capabilities to customer objectives, expected outcomes, stakeholders, and adoption milestones.
* Drive adoption through proactive customer engagement, use case reviews, release awareness, business check-ins, and practical guidance on relevant Brightlayer functionality.

**Retention, Renewal Readiness, and Growth**  

* Monitor customer health across adoption, engagement, satisfaction, support trends, renewal timing, stakeholder alignment, and relationship quality.
* Develop renewal-readiness plans with Sales and Commercial Operations to support retention, reduce churn risk, and improve forecast predictability.
* Identify customer success risks and expansion opportunities early, then coordinate cross-functional action plans to protect outcomes and support growth.

**Tech-Touch, Digital Engagement, and AI-Enabled Scale**  

* Help define tech-touch, digital-touch, automated, and AI-assisted engagement models that scale customer success beyond high-touch coverage.
* Contribute to the evaluation, implementation, and optimization of a customer success platform and supporting digital workflows.
* Use AI-enabled capabilities responsibly to improve customer insights, account prioritization, health scoring, renewal risk detection, communications, and repeatable CS workflows.

**Customer Insights and Voice of Customer**  

* Capture customer feedback, business needs, product gaps, and emerging market requirements to serve as an internal advocate for Brightlayer customers.
* Share actionable Voice of Customer insights with Product, Offer Management, Support, Services, Sales, and Commercial Operations to inform roadmap, service, and customer experience improvements.

**Operations, Analytics, and Process Excellence**  

* Track customer success metrics, including adoption, renewal rate, churn risk, customer health, engagement, satisfaction, and value realization.
* Use CRM, customer success tools, dashboards, and analytics to prioritize accounts, identify risks, and inform business recommendations.
* Support the development of customer success processes, playbooks, reporting standards, health-scoring approaches, and operating rhythms.
* Provide regular reporting and insights to leadership on customer health, adoption trends, renewal readiness, and customer success performance.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**  

* Collaborate with Product, Solutions Architects, Professional Services, Customer Support, Offer Management, Commercial Operations, and Sales to coordinate customer outcomes.
* Ensure customer expectations, requirements, and deliverables are clearly understood across internal teams.
* Influence cross-functional stakeholders to remove barriers, accelerate customer outcomes, and improve the overall Brightlayer customer experience.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Basic Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in customer success, account management, commercial operations, customer operations, SaaS, product, or technology-driven customer-facing roles.
* Minimum 5 years of experience working in a B2B software, services, technology, or digital solutions environment.
* Minimum 5 years of experience with customer relationship management systems or customer success tools.
* No relocation is offered for this role.
* Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.

  
  
**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Experience in Enterprise SaaS, industrial software, energy management, power management, electrical infrastructure, digital transformation, or connected solutions.
* Experience developing customer success processes, playbooks, health scoring model

new_jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager - xMatters
new_jobs.description:
The **Customer Success Manager (CSM)** is a customer-facing technical role within the Global Account Management and Customer Success organization. This role helps strategic xMatters customers adopt the solution, realize value, and achieve their business goals, supporting customer retention and growth.

As part of the Account Management team, the CSM drives xMatters adoption, value realization, customer satisfaction, and retention across an assigned portfolio. The CSM works across the organization as the voice of the customer, sharing feedback and helping remove barriers to adoption and success.

The CSM is a technical subject matter expert in xMatters and its use cases. In partnership with Account Managers, the CSM shares best practices, provides strategic guidance, and helps customers address complex challenges. The CSM also coordinates internal resources for at-risk customers and contributes to a strong, lasting customer experience.

### **What you'll do:**

Build deep technical and business knowledge of xMatters and its use cases. Work directly with customers to configure functionality, demonstrate capabilities, and identify additional ways to use the solution.

Lead adoption and customer success for assigned strategic xMatters accounts in support of retention and growth goals.

Apply knowledge of the industry, customer operations, and emerging needs to recommend relevant xMatters use cases. Develop practical adoption strategies that align with each customer’s goals.

Develop and lead adoption plans that support customer satisfaction goals, including an NPS score above 50. Monitor progress, identify product or business barriers, and coordinate actions to resolve them.

Review customer health and usage metrics, and develop processes and tools that improve xMatters adoption.

Partner with Account Managers on account plans, customer business challenges, risk mitigation, and opportunities to grow relationships.

Coordinate internal teams to resolve complex customer issues.

* Conduct customer health checks by reviewing progress against documented success criteria. Present findings and recommendations that help customers increase the value and use of xMatters.

* Develop practical approaches for customers whose needs are not met by standard configurations, working within product capabilities and established processes.

* Identify potential upsell and cross-sell opportunities through customer success conversations, and refer them to the assigned Account Executive or Account Manager for follow-up.

* Lead customer communications about xMatters product introductions, releases, enhancements, user group meetings, webinars, and other strategic initiatives.

* Share customer feedback with management and contribute to strategic initiatives and program improvements, including coordination with Product on feature requests and roadmap priorities.

* Partner with Implementation and Professional Services teams to understand the status of xMatters engagements and support a smooth transition from deployment to ongoing account management and customer success.

* Work with Product Management to prioritize customer feature requests, identify capability gaps, and communicate product barriers to adoption and effective use.

### **What you'll bring:**

* At least 3 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as pre-sales engineering or consulting, or implementing technical software solutions in DevOps, or major incident management (MIM).

* Experience providing technical account management for large organizations.

* Ability to connect product capabilities to customer needs, explain technical concepts clearly, and recommend ways to improve adoption and deliver measurable value.

* A track record of improving customer retention and growth through a customer-first approach in a complex software environment.

* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate challenging situations professionally with customers and internal teams.

* Strong organization and judgment, with the ability to prioritize work across multiple customers and adjust as needs change.

* Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to engage effectively with executive and C-level stakeholders.

* Ability to work independently with integrity and accountability.

* Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

* Resilience, curiosity, and a customer-first mindset. Builds trust with customers and colleagues and contributes to shared team success.

* Technical experience with agile delivery, CI/CD, SaaS or cloud environments, REST web services, Java or JavaScript (or other programming experience), ITIL, MIM, NOC or incident processes, and operations monitoring.

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology or a related field.

### **Bonus to have:**

* Ability to explain the value of approaches such as Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, ITIL, NOC/SRE, or MIM.

* Experience or training in implementing web-based software applications.

* Experience with Salesforce, Gainsight, Totango, Pendo, or similar tools for tracking adoption and value realization.

new_jobs.title: Emergency Case Manager
new_jobs.description:
ResponseAI is seeking experienced Emergency Case Managers to support rapid emergency response through client intake, needs assessments, temporary-assistance coordination, and referrals at emergency sites.

This position will be **ON CALL** and the applicant must be able to deploy anywhere in the United States within 24hrs for up to 14 days.

**Education**: Bachelor’s degree in Social work, Psychology, Human Services, Emergency Management, Public Health, or a related field.

**Experience**: 3+ years of human services case management experience, including support for individuals, families, or vulnerable populations during emergencies, disasters, crisis response, or other time-sensitive human services operations.

**Responsibilities & Required Skills**

* Conduct intake interviews and needs assessments; develop case plans for individuals experiencing crisis or displacement, collect and analyze information, and provide practical assistance.
* Coordinate temporary assistance, referrals, and social services; apply knowledge of TANF, SNAP, Vocational Rehabilitation Services, Medicaid, and community support programs.
* Support children, older adults, individuals with disabilities, and people with medical or behavioral health needs.
* Apply trauma-informed care, crisis intervention, de-escalation, cultural competency, mandatory reporting, and confidentiality requirements.
* Coordinate with federal, state, tribal, territorial, local, and community partners to maintain continuity of services.
* Prepare clear, concise case documentation and reports; use electronic case management systems or learn Government-designated systems within 30 days.
* Prioritize competing demands and adapt to rapidly changing, fast-paced emergency response requirements.
* Develop Section 508-compliant reporting and briefing products; demonstrate proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.

**1099 Compensation & Deployment**

Activation:$55–$65/hr

Training:$45–$55/hr
